title: Regional Manager
description:
Business manager professionals—take your next career step with a global industrial distribution company that combines strategic business & sales leadership with P&L responsibility.

Applied Industrial Technologies (a Fortune 1000 company) is the largest stocking industrial distributor in North America with a customer focused organization, providing value added services through consultative sales and application knowledge to demonstrate tangible ROI for our customers.

Applied Industrial Technologies’ company culture is friendly, fun with healthy competition and rewards. We offer integrity, inclusion, and career advancement. Individual contributions and ideas are encouraged and welcomed.

We realize we are only as strong as our dedicated team. Selling millions of industrial products to all types of customers takes a special team and that's where you come in.

Why join us?

Applied earned its place as one of the World’s Best Employers by Forbes for 2021. We are #87out of the top 50 distributors in North America in 2024, as well as the Outstanding Employer Support award from the U.S. Navy. We are a GSA approved vendor.

Applied has been fortunate to retain associates who have built long lasting careers. 25% of our US team has 20+ years of service!

In addition to competitive pay including quarterly and annual bonus opportunities and all the benefits you’d expect from an industry leader (company vehicle, 401K with company match, insurance, time off, employee assistance, tuition reimbursement, etc.) we also provide:

  • Health, vision, dental, 401k with company match, vacation, tuition reimbursement
  • A LASTING CAREER – Career paths are available in sales or management throughout the country
  • Professional development and training
  • A local support team partnership to provide customers with stellar service

In accordance with applicable wage transparency law requirements, the typical first year total compensation pay range for the Regional Manager position is $110,000- $160,000 per year, depending on earned quarterly and annual incentive payments.

What you’ll do:

As Regional Manager, you will lead all business initiatives in 6 locations requiring 5-8 nights per month of overnight travel. You will be responsible for providing strategic and tactical business leadership in the development and execution of the region P&L, sales, and operations strategy.

This position oversees our Service Centers in Denver, Colorado Springs, and Craig, CO, as well as Gillette, Casper, and Cheyenne, WY, and reports directly to the Area Vice President. The role can be based in either Colorado or Wyoming.

  • Develop, lead, and implement the region’s P&L programs, strategic & tactical activities for multiple locations.
  • Establishing relationships with the local General Managers who lead the Service Centers in the region.
  • Manage and grow existing and new customer opportunities using company business processes and cadence.
  • Manage all aspects of the region to meet customer needs and company profitability goals in headcount, inventory, margin, and net income
  • Hire, train, & develop strong performing team players.
  • Prepare management reports and presentations as required
  • Leadership by example. Create a positive, dynamic, and fun work environment

Qualifications

A Regional Manager brings credibility to the region through performance, professional qualifications, and leadership skills as well as leading by example.

  • Documented success proactively managing P&L.
  • 5+ years’ experience of proven strategic and tactical business leadership evaluating and implementing comprehensive customer service and sales programs and initiatives
  • Four-year degree or equivalent work experience
  • Demonstrated background in talent management and associate development to build and retain highly motivated performance teams
  • Excellent interpersonal communication, presentation, and organizational skills with all levels of internal and external organizations
  • Mechanical aptitude in order to maximize your product knowledge and help guide customers to solutions
  • Systems proficiency in ERP and computer related systems
  • Ability to travel 50% of the time as needed
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the US. We are not able to offer sponsorship of work visas for this position.

If you love building business teams & results, apply now for immediate consideration!

#LI-TH1

Founded in 1923, Applied Industrial Technologies (NYSE: AIT) is a leading value-added distributor and technical solutions provider of industrial motion, fluid power, flow control, automation technologies, and related maintenance supplies. Our leading brands, specialized services, and comprehensive knowledge serve MRO and OEM end users in virtually all industrial markets through our multi-channel capabilities that provide choice, convenience, and expertise.

Applied Industrial Technologies is built on a philosophy that puts people first. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a workforce in which we enforce fair treatment and provide growth opportunities for everyone. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Insurance AR Specialist
description:
At OSS Health, our mission is to continually strive to be the healthcare leader in quality, innovation and value. We make every effort to understand and exceed the expectations and needs of our patients. We are committed to providing an environment that is safe, respectful, and dignified at all times.

Joining OSS Health means joining a culture of excellence and teamwork, with a strong focus on employee development and community support. OSS Health offers a great work environment, professional development opportunities, meaningful careers, and competitive compensation.

Are you ready to provide a 5-star “OSSOME” experience? Apply today!

JOB SUMMARY:

The Insurance AR Specialist is a key member of the Revenue Cycle team responsible for ensuring that the organization receives proper reimbursement by reviewing payer requirements, correction of errors and supporting Patient Financial Services and the patients with billing inquiries.

SCHEDULE:

Monday- Friday, 40 hours per week

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Verify claim accuracy, including demographics, insurance coverage, coding, modifiers and required documentation.
  • Correct and resubmit rejected or denied claims promptly
  • Communicate with payers to resolve delays, denials and underpayments.
  • Document all account activity in billing systems per department standards.
  • Review denial codes and explanation of benefits (EOBs) to determine root causes
  • Initiate corrections, appeals or re-billing procedures as needed.
  • Work with coding, clinical and front-end teams to prevent recurring errors.
  • Assist patients and patient financial services with billing questions, statements, and balance questions.
  • Ensure billing practices comply with payer policies, CMS regulations and organizational standards.
  • Maintain thorough, accurate records of billing actions and follow-ups.
  • Support audits and quality reviews.
  • Escalates difficult or recurring issues to the Revenue Cycle Manager to identify a trend, resolve the isolated issue or render correction to the billing process.
  • Demonstrates good judgment in safeguarding OSS information to include confidentiality of all medical and patient information.
  • Resolution of any Coordination of Benefits, Self-Pay Adjustments or Bundled Pricing
  • Follows all policies and procedures of OSS.
  • Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • High school diploma or equivalent is required; Associate Degree or Accredited Certificate from a Medical Billing program is preferred.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 2 years’ experience in medical insurance billing for a hospital, clinic, or doctor’s office.
  • Must be detail oriented and possess excellent organizational skills, time management and communication skills
  • Must have a working understanding of hospital and/or physician claim requirements for Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial Healthcare Insurance.
  • Must be able to prioritize duties and communicate directly with insurance companies, patients, physicians, co-workers and vendors.
  • Must be a team player and willing to work with all staff to get the overall job accomplished. Must maintain a cooperative working relationship with all and handle difficult situations tactfully.
  • Experience with Medent, CPSI and SSI software preferred.
  • Must have the ability to review and understand written material pertaining to orthopedics and general healthcare, including terminology and reimbursement issues.
  • Basic knowledge of reading and interpreting a payer EOB (explanation of benefits)

BENEFITS INCLUDE:

  • Competitive Wages
  • Medical, Dental, Vision available on the first day of employment
  • Disability, and Life Insurance within 90 days
  • Company-Paid Group Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability & Long-Term Disability
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k) plan and profit sharing
  • Career Advancement Opportunities

title: Associate Director, Global Manufacturing Communications
description:
Job Description

The Associate Director, Global Manufacturing Communications is a unique opportunity to join our Company as a key member of the Global Corporate Affairs and Manufacturing organizations.


This role supports the development and implementation of multi-channel internal and external communications across site, product, supply, crisis, and enterprise priorities.


The position requires a communications professional who can connect manufacturing operations, supply chain management, and reputation considerations to clear stakeholder messaging, site-level communications strategies, and execution plans for our manufacturing site in West Point, PA, representing approximately 7,500 employees.


The successful candidate will report to our Manufacturing Division Site Communications Director, U.S. and operate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This hybrid role requires onsite presence two to three days per week, with travel to other U.S. locations as needed.


Primary Responsibilities


Integrated Communications


  • Develop and execute integrated communications and editorial strategies that support divisional, site, and regional priorities.
  • Connect site performance to the broader enterprise narrative for both wired and non-wired employees.
  • Communicate how manufacturing performance, supply continuity, product milestones, and operational readiness impact patients, customers, employees, and company reputation.
  • Measure audience reach, engagement, and effectiveness of communication efforts.

Site Storytelling and Transformation


  • Identify, develop, and support compelling storylines that highlight site achievements and business accomplishments.
  • Support organizational transformation initiatives through effective change management communications.
  • Develop workforce engagement opportunities that strengthen awareness and understanding of site priorities.

Leadership Counsel and Preparation


  • Advise site leadership on strategic communications approaches.
  • Develop supporting communications plans, programs, and materials.
  • Prepare leaders for: Employee town halls Speaking engagements Local announcements Community interactions Government and industry events Media engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with policy and media relations teams when appropriate.

Campaigns, Social Media, and AI Integration


  • Lead multi-channel communication campaigns across employee communication platforms.
  • Develop content that reaches both wired and non-wired employee populations.
  • Integrate approved AI technologies into content creation, workflow management, and insight generation while ensuring appropriate oversight, confidentiality, accuracy, and approvals.

Content and Review Management


  • Manage development and review of communication materials, including Briefing documents, Talking points, Site newsletters, Digital signage content and Core response documents.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders to facilitate timely reviews and approvals.

Risk and Crisis Communications


  • Help reduce organizational risk by educating employees on policies and escalating potential reputational concerns.
  • Partner with divisional communications teams to assess risks and prioritize actions.
  • Anticipate emerging issues and develop scenario-based response plans.
  • Develop key messages and leader talking points to support rapid response to: Quality events Safety incidents Supply interruptions Business continuity events Activism-related issues Media inquiries other reputation-sensitive situations.

Required Qualifications, Experience, and Skills


  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, Journalism, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of communications experience.
  • Proven experience developing and executing integrated internal and external communications strategies.
  • Experience supporting: Employee engagement Executive communications Media preparedness Product communications Supply communications Change management initiatives Stakeholder issues management.
  • Experience supporting site-level organizational changes.
  • Experience supporting site launches or major operational milestones is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of the biopharmaceutical industry and manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated business acumen and understanding of how product strategy, supply reliability, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and stakeholder perceptions influence communications planning.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and advise senior leaders.
  • Experience providing strategic communications counsel and supporting crisis communications activities.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate scientific, technical, and business information into compelling communications.
  • Proficiency with social media and digital communication channels.
  • Familiarity with approved AI tools and emerging communications practices.
  • Excellent project management skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Experience managing communications reviews under tight timelines.
  • Experience working with public relations agencies and managing project budgets.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and multiple stakeholder groups effectively.
  • Demonstrated issues-management experience, including identification of emerging issues, risk assessment, and coordination of aligned responses.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted relationships across multiple sites and stakeholder groups.
  • Ability to operate independently while thriving in a matrixed, high-visibility environment.

Preferred Experience and Skills


  • Experience supporting our Research & Development Division, manufacturing organizations, or complex operational communications.
  • Experience directly advising site leadership teams.
  • Experience working within a global pharmaceutical, healthcare, or biotechnology organization.
  • Understanding of how manufacturing operates across a global enterprise network.
  • Experience developing communications programs for wired and non-wired employee populations.
  • Experience supporting labor-relations communications.
  • Proven media relations experience, including building relationships with local, industry, and trade media.
  • Experience managing communications budgets and agency partnerships independently.

Required Skills:

Communications Planning, Crisis Communication Management, Educational Materials Development, Employee Communications, Issue Management, Media Interaction, Project Management, Public Relations (PR), Public Relations Services, Strategic Communications

title: Parasitology Technician I (Overnight Shift - TEMP)
description:
We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that’s why we’re inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other’s growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Today Antech is driving the future of pet health as part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a family-owned company focused on veterinary care.

Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs.

Work Shift: 11pm-7:30am Monday–Saturday, With Two Scheduled Days Off Each Week. Weekend Coverage Is Required.

This is the standard workweek; however, schedules are subject to change and overtime may be required based on operational and business needs.


The Target Pay for this position is $18.80 an hour. At Antech, pay decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, education, training and budget.


This is a temporary position lasting 3-6 months.


Job Purpose/Overview

The Parasitology Laboratory Aide is responsible for the collection, processing and preparing of fecal samples.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Collect fecal specimens from login, scan into loads, and prepare for set up.
  • Meet all minimum department requirements for para loads and Fcombo set-up rates.
  • Accurately building loads and label processing tubes
  • Split specimens for Giardia ELISA when required
  • Find missing specimens. Print and reconcile queue list
  • Maintain organization of storage refrigerator
  • Maintain all equipment including hoods, centrifuges, etc.
  • Awareness of quality control and calibration
  • Crosstrain and develop knowledge of multiple specialties within department/lab.
  • Follows applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOP's), including safety and quality procedures. Maintains clean and organized work area. Restocks supplies as needed
  • Participates in improving lab efficiency, quality, and cooperation.
  • Consult with senior peers on non-complex Parasitology tasks to learn through experience.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


We share a collaborative obligation to ensure that we conduct ourselves in the utmost ethical manner and that we hold each other accountable to the values and standards of the organization. Every Associate is responsible for asking questions, seeking guidance, and reporting concerns and/or violations of company policy or ethical standards. Antech Diagnostics has several processes in place to communicate with leadership and expects that Associates will have a commitment to integrity and uncompromising values.


Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Attention to detail and organized with ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Proficiency in the English language which allows for participation in team meetings, accurate entry of data into company systems and understanding of written directions
  • Positive, can-do attitude


Working Conditions

  • Stationary Position- must be able to remain in a stationary position for up to 2 hours.
  • Constantly operates lab equipment accurately and efficiently
  • Occasionally required to bend, kneel, stoop, or crouch
  • Required to lift, move, and carry up to 20 lbs.
  • The ability to observe details at close range
  • Extended hours may be needed
  • Laboratory environments with potential biohazards present that are mitigated by the mandatory use of PPE
  • Receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new assignments
  • Work under close to moderate supervision
  • Potential for exposure to agents known to cause zoonotic disease in humans and use of potentially hazardous chemicals as defined by the National Hazard Communication Standards. A complete list of such chemicals is available from department supervision

About Antech

Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90+ reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board-certified specialist support services.

Benefits

Antech offers an industry competitive benefits package and continues to invest in and evolve benefits programs that meet the health, wellness and financial needs of our associates.

Benefits eligiblity is based on employment status.

  • Paid Time Off & Holidays

  • Medical, Dental, Vision (Multiple Plans Available)

  • Basic Life (Company Paid) & Supplemental Life

  • Short and Long Term Disability (Company Paid)

  • Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Tuition/Continuing Education Reimbursement

  • Life Assistance Program

  • Pet Care Discounts

Commitment to Equal Employer Opportunities

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. For a complete EEO statement, please see our Career page at Antech Careers.

description:

title: Analyst - Learning Experience & Facilitation
description:
Overview

Who we are

Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Toyota. As one of the world’s most admired brands, Toyota is growing and leading the future of mobility through innovative, high-quality solutions designed to enhance lives and delight those we serve. We’re looking for talented team members who want to Dream. Do. Grow. with us.

Toyota does not offer support or sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based visas or any other work authorization for this role now or in the future. You must have the right to work in the United States and not require Toyota support or sponsorship for immigration-related employment (e.g., H-1B, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, TN, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, ‘job flexibility benefits’ [also known as I-140 or Adjustment of Status portability], etc.) now or in the future. You should not apply for this role if you will require Toyota to assist with immigration support or sponsorship now or in the future.​

Who we’re looking for

Toyota’s Human Resources Talent Development Department is looking for a passionate and highly motivated Learning Experience & Facilitation Analyst.

Reporting to the Learning Experience & Facilitation Manager, the person in this role will support the department’s objective to enable team member development through experience, exposure, and education, while ensuring orientation and facilitated learning programs are operationally excellent, learner-centered, and continuously improving.

This position is based in Plano, Texas. The selected candidate will be expected to reside within commutable distance of this location.

What you’ll be doing

  • Maintain end-to-end onboarding administration and delivery. Coordinate executive and non-executive new hire orientation, including rosters, communications, scheduling, learning materials, shared mailbox support, virtual meeting production, I-9 process coordination, reporting, and day-of logistics.
  • Facilitate high-quality learning experiences. Deliver onboarding and selected leadership or professional development content in person and virtually; create an inclusive environment, manage learner engagement, adapt delivery to audience needs, and model strong facilitation practices.
  • Serve as an onboarding process subject matter resource. Partner with Talent Acquisition, IT, HR Business Advisors, policy and compliance partners, technical teams, and other stakeholders to resolve onboarding issues, clarify ownership, and maintain standardized practices.
  • Analyze and improve program performance. Monitor participation, learner feedback, operational issues, and recurring service needs; produce reports, identify trends and root causes, and recommend practical improvements to content, tools, communications, and workflows.
  • Coordinate learning programs and resources. Manage calendars, training rooms, materials, content inventories, distribution lists, meeting logistics, special events, vendor support, and other program needs across Training & Learning.
  • Support content and experience design. Create and update facilitator guides, presentations, participant resources, communications, job aids, and basic digital or SharePoint content using adult learning and instructional design principles.
  • Lead assigned projects and working teams. Plan and execute onboarding or facilitation initiatives across functions and locations, track milestones and risks, facilitate stakeholder decisions, and support broader Training & Learning priorities as needed.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher, or equivalent professional work experience, in Human Resources, Training and Development, Organization Development, Talent Development, Education, or a closely related field.
  • Experience coordinating onboarding, training, learning, talent development, or other high-touch employee programs.
  • Facilitation and public speaking experience, with the ability to engage in-person and virtual audiences.
  • Project and program management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, risks, and detailed logistics.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze information, generate reports, identify process gaps, and translate findings into recommendations or improvements.
  • Strong customer service, written communication, verbal communication, and relationship-building skills across organizational levels.
  • High attention to detail and sound judgment when handling time-sensitive, confidential, compliance-related, or new hire information.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 10%.

Added bonus if you have

  • Experience with I-9 management, Equifax I-9, Workday, onboarding tickets, or related HR systems.
  • Experience using adult learning, instructional design, or learning experience design practices to develop facilitator and learner resources.
  • Experience partnering with executives, managing vendors, or supporting programs across multiple locations or business units.
  • Experience with virtual production, learning technologies, SharePoint site maintenance, basic visual design, or course development.
  • Toyota Way Global Content experience.
  • JKK and TBP course and project completion.

What We’ll Bring

  • A work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect ​
  • Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career, as well as tuition reimbursement ​
  • Team Member Vehicle Purchase Discount ​
  • Toyota Team Member Lease Vehicle Program (if applicable) ​
  • Comprehensive health care and wellness plans for your entire family ​
  • Toyota 401(k) Savings Plan featuring a company match, as well as an annual retirement contribution from Toyota regardless of whether you contribute (if applicable) ​
  • Paid holidays and paid time off ​
  • Referral services related to prenatal services, adoption, childcare, schools and more ​
  • Tax Advantaged Accounts (Health Savings Account, Health Care FSA, Dependent Care FSA) ​
  • Relocation assistance (if applicable) ​

Belonging at Toyota


Our success begins and ends with our people. We embrace all perspectives and value unique human experiences. Respect for all is our North Star.


Applicants for our positions are considered without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, religion, military or veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law.


Have a question, need assistance with your application or do you require any special accommodations? Please send an email to talent.acquisition@toyota.com.

title: UX/UI Designer, Transportation & Powersports
description:
We are seeking a UX/UI Designer specialized in transportation and human-machine interfaces (HMI) to design the future of digital cockpits for our recreational vehicles. In this strategic role, you will be responsible for creating seamless, intuitive, and safe interactive experiences tailored to the demanding realities of off-roading (vibrations, gloved operation, glare, and high cognitive load). You will work closely with engineering, industrial design, and customer experience (CX) teams to bridge physical controls and digital displays, aiming for a seamless symbiosis between the rider and their machine.

YOU'LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:

  • Tailored Interface Design: Create user interfaces (UI) and information architectures (UX) optimized for recreational vehicles, minimizing cognitive load while providing rapid access to primary and secondary functions.
  • Physical & Digital Integration: Ensure seamless alignment between physical vehicle controls (buttons, dials) and the on-screen display, taking into account constraints both in motion and at a standstill.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Develop user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity interactive prototypes (Figma, etc.) for features such as navigation (GPS, group ride), vehicle telemetry, and media integration (Apple CarPlay, Android Auto).
  • Design for Extreme Environments: Adapt visual and interactive ergonomics to harsh environmental conditions (high-contrast visibility in bright sunlight, enlarged touch targets for gloved hands, readability during heavy vibrations).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with software engineering teams (embedded systems, Android) to ensure technical feasibility, respect performance budgets (latency, refresh rates), and maintain alignment with brand DNA.
  • User Research: Participate in field-testing sessions to gather real-world data and iterate on design concepts to continuously streamline the user experience.


YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING SKILLS AND QUALITIES:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Interaction/Industrial Design, Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), Ergonomics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 6 years of UX/UI design experience, with a proven track record in the mobility, automotive, or transportation industries (in-vehicle displays or HMI design).
  • Advanced expertise in Figma and other interactive prototyping tools.
  • Deep understanding of driving-related cognitive ergonomics (glance time, Fitts's law, driver distraction management).
  • Familiarity with the constraints of embedded operating systems (e.g., Android Automotive) and real-time 3D asset integration.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing solutions to complex software/hardware interface challenges.
  • Experience with 3D interface integration (Unreal Engine, Blender).

WHEN IT COMES TO BENEFITS AT BRP, WE GO ALL OUT.

It starts with a solid foundation. We have what you're looking for:

  • Annual bonus based on company financial performance

  • Generous paid time off

  • Retirement plan

  • Group savings options

  • Eligibility for health and dental plans, life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, and travel insurance

  • Maternity and parental benefits

  • Free parking available

  • Team-building activities

  • Wellness program


Why not get even more:

  • Flexible work schedules

  • Summer schedule (varies by department and location)

  • Holiday shutdown period

  • Educational resources

  • Discounts on BRP products


Salary Range: 74 900$ to 105 000$ per year

Hours: 37.5 hours / week

Start Date: As soon as possible

Employment Type: Permanent full-time

Shift: Day shift

The employee is eligible for standard company insurance and benefits.

WELCOME TO BRP

A global leader in the world of recreational vehicles and boats, we create innovative ways to move on snow, water, asphalt, dirt, and... even in the air. Headquartered in Valcourt, Quebec, our company is rooted in a tradition of ingenuity and a dedicated focus on our customers. Today, we have manufacturing facilities in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Finland, Australia, and Austria. We rely on nearly 17,000 dynamic people driven by the deep belief that in work, as in life, it’s not about the destination. It’s about the ride. Yours.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Engineering Projects


Summary:

We're working with an established and growing engineering consultancy that delivers a range of projects across the pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device industries. An opportunity has arisen for an experienced Project Manager to join the team in Cork, taking responsibility for the delivery of engineering projects within regulated manufacturing environments.


The Role:

  • Lead engineering projects involving equipment installations, upgrades and modifications, managing delivery from initial scope through to completion.
  • Develop and manage project schedules, budgets, resources and key milestones.
  • Coordinate activities across engineering, manufacturing, maintenance, quality and external contractors.
  • Oversee equipment procurement, installation, commissioning and qualification activities.
  • Monitor project performance, identify potential risks and implement solutions to keep projects on track.
  • Ensure project activities comply with site safety procedures, quality standards and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Manage relationships with vendors, contractors and internal stakeholders.
  • Provide regular project updates, maintain accurate documentation and support continuous improvement initiatives.


What We're Looking For:

  • Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • 3–5+ years' experience managing engineering projects.
  • Proven track record delivering equipment installations, upgrades or capital engineering projects.
  • Strong planning, organisational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and coordinate stakeholders effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills and a practical, solutions-focused approach.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device or other regulated manufacturing environments would be an advantage.

title: Mechanical Project Manager
description:
The Opportunity

I'm working with a specialist engineering contractor seeking an experienced Mechanical Project Manager to join their team on a major project at Intel in Leixlip.

This is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of a significant mechanical installation package within one of Ireland's most technically demanding industrial and semiconductor environments.

The successful candidate will oversee the delivery of mechanical and piping works, managing site teams, subcontractors, programme and commercial performance while ensuring the highest standards of safety and quality throughout the project.


The Role

Reporting to senior project management, you will take responsibility for the successful delivery of the mechanical package, from planning and procurement through to installation, testing and final handover.


Key responsibilities will include:

  • Taking full ownership of the mechanical piping package and ensuring successful project delivery.
  • Managing mechanical installation works, with a particular focus on piping systems.
  • Coordinating site supervisors, engineers, pipefitters, specialist subcontractors and installation teams.
  • Managing project programmes, labour resources, procurement and material requirements.
  • Reviewing technical drawings, specifications and installation methodologies.
  • Coordinating with the client, main contractor and other project stakeholders.
  • Monitoring project costs, variations, progress claims and commercial performance.
  • Ensuring all works are delivered in accordance with project specifications and quality requirements.
  • Overseeing QA/QC documentation, inspections, testing and commissioning.
  • Driving health and safety standards across all mechanical activities.
  • Identifying and resolving technical, logistical and programme-related challenges.


The Ideal Candidate

  • Previous experience as a Mechanical Project Manager within an M&E or specialist mechanical contractor.
  • Strong background in mechanical installation and piping systems.
  • Experience managing mechanical packages on large-scale industrial, pharmaceutical, semiconductor or data centre projects.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical construction, pipework installation and technical drawings.
  • Proven ability to manage site teams, subcontractors and project stakeholders.
  • Experience with project planning, procurement, cost control and programme management.
  • Excellent organisational, communication and leadership skills.
  • A relevant Mechanical Engineering, Building Services or equivalent technical qualification.
  • Experience working within a live Intel, semiconductor or cleanroom environment would be a significant advantage.


What's on Offer?

  • Excellent salary and overall package, up to €110k.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of a significant mechanical package.
  • Exposure to a prestigious Intel project.
  • Work alongside experienced engineering and construction professionals.
  • Long-term career development within a specialist engineering contractor.
  • Opportunity to further develop your experience in semiconductor and advanced manufacturing environments.

title: Child Safety Researcher
description:
Alice is seeking a highly skilled, resilient, and technical Child Safety Researcher to join our London team supporting Generative AI safety initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a core Subject Matter Expert (SME) on online child exploitation, grooming, and abuse—bringing deep expertise in how these harms manifest across digital ecosystems, communities, and emerging technologies. You will evaluate high-risk, complex child safety scenarios across Generative AI modalities, conduct proactive threat intelligence research to track evolving offender tactics, and build technical automations to scale dataset analysis and policy enforcement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Child Safety Subject Matter Expertise & Adjudication: Review, validate, and classify complex, graphic, and sensitive child safety cases across Generative AI modalities.
  • Online Harm & Threat Intelligence Research: Track how child sexual exploitation and abuse (CSAE/CSAM), grooming networks, and offender communities operate and evolve online—conducting trend analysis and signal extraction during lower-volume evaluation periods to anticipate emerging risks.
  • Adversarial Testing: Design and run adversarial tests across a wide range of AI systems: text, image, video and multimodal models, as well as emerging modalities like text-to-3D and physical AI. This includes jailbreaks and adversarial prompts, along with new testing approaches suited to each system.
  • Product and policy mapping: Connect real-world risks to specific AI products and features. Make sure testing reflects how products are actually used and helps inform policy where it’s still being defined.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of specialized experience in online child safety, trust & safety investigations, CSAM/CSAE policy enforcement, or child protection threat intelligence.
  • Deep Child Safety Domain Mastery: Comprehensive understanding of online child safety harms, including offender methodologies, online grooming dynamics, CSAM/CSAE typologies, evasion tactics, and how these harms manifest across online platforms and digital communities.
  • Generative AI & Adversarial Testing Experience: Hands-on experience evaluating, red-teaming, or stress-testing Generative AI systems (LLMs, image/video, multimodal, or emerging modalities), including designing jailbreaks, adversarial prompts, and structured test suites.
  • Product & Policy Translation: Proven ability to map threat intelligence to product features and partner with policy, legal, or engineering teams to draft or refine safety standards in ambiguous environments.
  • Technical & Data Skills: Hands-on experience writing scripts (e.g., Python, Bash) and building local automations to parse datasets, extract patterns, and streamline investigative workflows.
  • Content Resilience: Demonstrated psychological resilience and willingness to handle continuous exposure to graphic, harsh, and distressing child safety material.
  • Workplace & Security Compliance: Ability to work full-time (5 days a week) on-site at our London office within a strictly secured, access-controlled environment.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with a proven ability to synthesize complex investigative findings into clear intelligence reports and actionable product recommendations.

About Alice

Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines.

In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection.

Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms.

If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

title: Senior Solution Architect, Cybersecurity Presales
description:
Position Summary


The Senior Solution Architect is a senior individual contributor within the Solution Architects team, reporting to the Senior Director of Customer Engineering.

Working closely with Sales Account Directors, you will take the technical lead on our largest and most complex opportunities, shaping solutions and developing compelling proposals across our Managed Security Services portfolio, including MDR, MRX and OT Advisory.

You will engage directly with clients, from security engineers to CISOs, lead complex bids and technical discussions, and ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, commercially viable and deliverable. As a senior member of the team, you will also contribute your expertise through knowledge sharing, technical guidance and the development of reusable presales assets.


Key Responsibilities


Bid Leadership and Solution Design

  • Lead the technical response for large, complex and strategic opportunities from initial discovery through proposal, clarification and solution defence.
  • Translate client business and security requirements into compelling Managed Security Services and Advisory solutions, covering architecture, scope, onboarding and ongoing operations.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions, client workshops, demonstrations and proof-of-value engagements.
  • Develop high-quality technical proposals, coordinating input from Sales, Delivery, Product, Legal and Commercial teams.
  • Identify technical risks, gaps and non-standard requirements early and ensure appropriate review before commitments are made.
  • Support pricing and commercial modelling with accurate sizing, effort and data-volume estimates.


Partnering with Sales

  • Act as the senior technical counterpart to Sales Account Directors on strategic accounts and major opportunities.
  • Build credibility with a broad range of client stakeholders, from engineers and security managers to CISOs and executives.
  • Support opportunity qualification and Go/No-Go decisions, providing a clear view of technical feasibility, complexity and delivery risk.
  • Articulate and defend Kudelski Security’s differentiation, ensuring solutions address the client’s underlying security and business challenges.
  • Maintain opportunity records, risks and solution decisions current in CRM so the wider team has full visibility.


Technical Depth and Team Contribution

  • Maintain strong knowledge of leading security technologies across SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud, OT and AI-enabled security, and how they integrate into Managed Security Services.
  • Stay current on cybersecurity market trends, client needs, competitor positioning and vendor roadmaps.
  • Develop and improve reusable presales assets, including reference architectures, proposal content, standard responses and demo environments.
  • Act as a technical escalation point and share expertise with colleagues through peer support, mentoring and enablement sessions.
  • Provide feedback to Product and Delivery teams based on evolving client and market requirements.


Skills and Experience


  • 10+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity presales, solution architecture, technical consulting or Managed Security Services.
  • Strong knowledge of security technologies across SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud, OT and emerging AI-enabled security capabilities.
  • Proven experience leading complex cybersecurity opportunities, bids and RFP responses.
  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to design solutions that balance client requirements, technical feasibility and deliverability.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage credibly with technical teams and senior executives.
  • Professional fluency in English and French.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to provide an objective technical perspective and challenge requirements when appropriate.
  • Self-directed and well organised, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative approach and willingness to share expertise and mentor colleagues as a senior individual contributor.
  • Relevant cybersecurity or vendor certifications are an advantage.


About Kudelski Security


Kudelski Security is the cybersecurity division of the Kudelski Group, a global leader in digital security for more than 30 years. We help large enterprises and public sector organisations across Europe and the United States manage cyber risk through managed detection and response, advisory services, offensive security testing, and emerging technology research. Our Cyber Fusion Centers in Switzerland, Spain and the United States run 24/7, backed by our own Threat Research and Counter Adversary Unit teams. We are known for being genuinely independent in the advice we give, and for building long-term partnerships with clients rather than selling one-off products. Our people work with the leading security platforms in the market. Our long-term approach to client partnerships enables continuous evaluation of security posture to reduce business risk, maintain compliance, and strengthen resilient cyber defense across IT and OT. With clients including Fortune 500 enterprises and large organizations across Europe and the United States, Kudelski Security addresses complex environments through expert-led, AI-powered security operations spanning advisory, managed risk and exposure, managed detection and response, and product security. For more information, visit www.kudelskisecurity.com.

title: Business Process Architect
description:
We are looking for:
A Process Architect to transform and scale Adobe’s global renewals processes and the customer journey that leads to them. This role will design, optimize and reimagine renewal processes and capabilities to improve the seller experience, streamline operations, protect revenue and fuel growth. You will lead cross functional efforts to architect scalable solutions that help renewal teams be more effective and efficient.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect the future state renewal processes & capabilities to drive scale, compliance and agility
  • Define & maintain the roadmap of capabilities, process improvements and initiatives needed to achieve the future state
  • Drive process definition and governance across the renewal lifecycle, from forecast through close
  • Design connected, end-to-end processes from sale through renewal, supporting the customer engagement platform
  • Partner with Sales Ops, Customer Success, and Product teams to ensure processes are intuitive, compliant, and aligned with business goals
  • Define how risk is identified, owned, and resolved across the customer lifecycle
  • Convert process designs into initial business requirements for technology teams
  • Develop and deploy tools, playbooks, and programs that increase renewal productivity and performance
  • Drive adoption of CRM, customer success, automation, and analytics platforms to reduce manual effort and improve renewal outcomes
  • Establish benchmarks and KPIs to measure renewal rate, forecast accuracy, productivity and process effectiveness

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive, cross-functional experience in Business Architecture and Process Improvement, driving enterprise transformation and operational excellence
  • Experience with renewals, customer journey, or post-sales processes and systems at SaaS companies
  • Expertise with CRM, such as Microsoft Dynamics or Salesforce, and experience with customer success and customer engagement platforms such as Gainsight
  • Demonstrated expertise in facilitating senior leaders and large cross-functional groups, using collaborative methods to align on strategy, process design, and measurable outcomes
  • Broad and practical knowledge of business architecture frameworks, methodologies, and tools, including capability mapping, value streams, operating models, and process documentation standards

title: Manager / Senior Manager SAP Business Transformation & Architecture
description:

Tasks

  • Bridge business and IT at senior level: Act as a trusted interface between client business leaders, IT leadership, enterprise architects, and delivery teams. Translate strategic business objectives into pragmatic SAP architecture concepts and transformation roadmaps.
  • Shape SAP enabled transformation programs: Assess clients' technology architectures, integration landscapes, process priorities, and transformation constraints. Recommend the optimal use of SAP S/4HANA (RISE and Grow), SAP Business Technology Platform, and related enterprise solutions.
  • Lead architecture and delivery teams: Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, consultants, technical specialists, client staff, and technology partners. Provide structure, direction, quality assurance, and escalation management across the full project lifecycle.
  • Drive innovation with practical business value: Identify and lead innovation initiatives across SAP, cloud, integration, data, analytics, automation, and AI enabled capabilities. Convert ideas into feasible solutions, prototypes, and scalable implementation approaches.
  • Own client relationships and stakeholder alignment: Manage senior stakeholder expectations, facilitate executive level discussions, and create clear decision materials that support alignment across business, IT, and program leadership.
  • Contribute to growth and business development: Lead or support sales cycles, proposal development, solution shaping, and account growth initiatives. Identify opportunities in existing client engagements and help convert them into high quality work.
  • Strengthen PwC thought leadership: Develop market facing content such as points of view, white papers, blog posts, client presentations, and conference material. Represent PwC credibly in client discussions and external forums.

Requirements

This opportunity is aimed at experienced professionals who can combine SAP architecture expertise, consulting leadership, and transformation delivery ownership. The profile is suitable for Manager and Senior Manager level candidates, depending on experience and demonstrated leadership scope.

Expected Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Natural Sciences, Business Informatics, Business Administration with technology focus, or a related field.
  • Senior SAP transformation experience: Several years of experience in SAP enabled business transformation, technology architecture, ERP modernization, or enterprise application advisory, ideally in a multi national environment.
  • Architecture depth: Strong understanding of SAP product portfolio, SAP S/4HANA architecture, integration patterns, cloud adoption, data flows, and product placement strategy.
  • SAP capability focus: Deep knowledge in one or more SAP S/4HANA core areas and/or SAP Business Technology Platform, including integration, extension, data, analytics, automation, or application development capabilities.
  • Transformation methodology: Solid know how of large ERP transformations, migration concepts, fit to standard approaches, transformation requirements, target operating models, and methodologies such as SAP Activate.
  • Leadership and delivery ownership: Proven ability to lead workstreams, manage teams, structure complex problems, assure quality, and drive delivery in demanding client environments.
  • Consulting and commercial mindset: Strong management consulting skills, including opportunity identification, proposal support, executive storytelling, business case thinking, and high quality presentation and pitching skills.
  • Learning agility: Ability to understand new technology concepts rapidly, challenge assumptions, and apply a proactive, ownership driven mindset.
  • Language skills: Excellent written and spoken English.

Desirable Qualifications
  • Advanced academic background: Target school background, MBA, PhD, or equivalent advanced qualification is a plus.
  • Local language skills: Fluent German or French are a strong plus.
  • Consulting with large organizations: Previous consulting experience with large organizations, complex programs, and senior stakeholder environments.
  • RfP and solutioning experience: Experience with request for proposal processes, solution shaping, effort estimation, and translating technical requirements into compelling presentation formats.
  • Certifications: Relevant SAP certifications such as P_SAPEA, P_BTPA, C_CPI, or comparable credentials are a plus.
  • Broader technology qualifications: Additional qualifications in Agile methods, Enterprise Architecture such as TOGAF, GenAI or machine learning, AWS, Azure, GCP, programming, databases, DevOps, or integration technologies are beneficial.

What We Offer
  • A platform to work on large scale SAP business transformation programs with leading organizations.
  • The opportunity to shape enterprise architecture, technology strategy, and implementation outcomes.
  • A collaborative environment with access to SAP, cloud, data, AI, and business transformation expertise across PwC.
  • A role with clear client impact, team leadership responsibility, and contribution to market growth.

Education

University

Languages

German, English

At PwC Switzerland, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're part of a tech-forward, people-empowered network and help clients build, accelerate and sustain momentum across audit, assurance, tax, legal, workforce, deals and consulting.

title: Chief Executive Officer , CEO
description:
Chief Executive Officer , CEO

I. Company Background and Strategic Context (Core Prerequisites for the Role)

Confidential Client (a subsidiary of a confidential investment group) was founded in 2019 by two investment entities, with an investment of over 500 million Egyptian pounds to date, introducing a fully automated production line, with an annual production capacity of 23,000 tons. The company's core business is processing shell eggs into pasteurized liquid eggs, frozen egg products, and egg powder products, primarily serving food manufacturers, hotels, restaurants, and catering customers (B2B) in the local and regional markets.

Key Strategic Shift: In 2025, the company rebranded and expanded from pure B2B industrial raw material supply to include powdered egg products and a full range of consumer products (C-end household use). This means the CEO must simultaneously manage the dual-engine growth of "large customer industrial supply" and "consumer brand building."

Current Leadership: The current Founder, Chairman & CEO remains actively involved. The newly hired CEO needs to possess strong operational execution and market expansion capabilities, filling the gap in day-to-day business management.

II. Job Description (JD)

Position Title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
Reports To: Executive Chairman of the Board
Location: Industrial Park, 6th of October City, Giza, Egypt (factory and headquarters location)

Key Responsibilities

  1. Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute the company's business strategy, annual objectives, and long-term growth plans.
  2. Operations Management: Oversee all factory operations, including production, maintenance, supply chain, procurement, warehousing, and distribution, ensuring operational efficiency and cost optimization.
  3. Financial Performance: Manage the company's financial performance, budgets, cash flow, profitability, and capital investments.
  4. Sales & Business Development: Lead sales and marketing strategies, develop new markets, strengthen customer relationships, and drive domestic and export business growth.

    B2B Business (Industrial and Food Service Channels)

    • Deepen existing B2B customer relationships: Consolidate cooperative relationships with food manufacturers, hotels, restaurant chains, and catering groups, increasing single-customer share and customer stickiness.
    • Export market development: Leverage existing export capabilities (BRCGS, ISO 9000, 22000, Halal and other certifications) to strengthen presence in the Middle East and African markets.
    • Large customer negotiation and contract management: Lead pricing strategy, long-term agreements, and key account relationship maintenance.

    B2C Business (Consumer Brands and Retail Channels)

    • Manage current consumer brand strategy: Leverage the existing brand positioning to expand C-end product lines and channel strategies for household scenarios.
    • Retail channel expansion and management: Manage and grow distribution networks with supermarkets, e-commerce platforms, and retail chains, managing channel pricing and promotion systems.
  5. Quality & Food Safety: Ensure compliance with food safety standards, quality management systems, regulatory requirements, and applicable certifications.
  6. Organizational Leadership: Lead and develop the management team, establish clear performance targets, and promote accountability and a high-performance culture.
  7. Corporate Governance: Ensure proper corporate governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, and effective reporting to the Executive Chairman.
  8. Investment & Expansion: Identify and evaluate business development opportunities, new products, capacity expansion, and strategic investments.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Revenue growth, profitability, production efficiency, cost control, product quality, food safety compliance, customer satisfaction, market expansion, and overall business performance.

Must-Have (Knockout Criteria):

  • Fluent in Arabic and English (business negotiations and board reporting).
  • Possesses actual decision-making authority as CEO / Business Head.
  • Has managed both B2B and B2C businesses (can be at different stages).

Preferred:

  • Experience in Egyptian local food manufacturing or FMCG enterprises.
  • Understanding of egg processing or liquid/frozen/powder food ingredient industry.
  • Experience in building and managing a C-end brand from scratch.

You will manage client engagements end to end, lead project teams, and contribute to business development and practice building. The role combines Swiss technical expertise, cross border advisory and reward structuring, in close collaboration with HR, finance and legal stakeholders of our clients.

Tasks

  • Shape cross-border employment tax and social security solutions for Swiss and international clients, advising on international workforce structures, special work arrangements, employer obligations and multi-country reporting requirements.
  • Design tax-efficient employment, compensation and reward structures for employees, senior executives and board members, including employment cost projections, equity and cash incentive plans, and practical guidance for HR, finance and legal stakeholders.
  • Guide clients through Swiss employment tax and social security matters, including withholding obligations, equity plans, pension and social security contributions, compensation policies, tax rulings, authority interactions and compliant employer practices.
  • Enable sustainable reward program implementation by establishing plan rules and policies, preparing ruling requests and tax communication, advising on Sell-to-Cover mechanics, reporting obligations and Swiss withholding requirements.
  • Lead complex advisory, including corporate restructuring and transaction-related projects.
  • Lead engagements from scoping to delivery, budgeting, WIP, billing, risk and profitability.
  • Develop trusted client relationships and a strong Employment and Reward Tax practice by coaching junior colleagues, contributing to proposals, pitches, RFPs, market activities, thought leadership and collaboration across service lines and jurisdictions.

Requirements

  • A university degree in Law, Economics, Business, Finance or a related field, combined with strong expertise in Swiss employment taxation, social security and reward-related advisory matters.
  • Typically, six to eight years of relevant experience in tax advisory, employment tax, compensation, reward, global mobility or a related field, ideally gained in a professional services firm, consulting environment or law firm.
  • Proven ability to manage client engagements and small teams, including project planning, prioritisation, technical review, budget control, WIP management, billing discipline, risk management and high-quality deliverable preparation.
  • Strong technical and practical understanding of cross-border employment structures, Swiss withholding obligations, equity compensation, social security, pensions, expense policies, incentive plans, tax rulings and employer reporting requirements.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and leadership skills, with a collaborative coaching mindset, commercial awareness and confidence contributing to business development, proposals and client relationship growth.
  • Native-level proficiency in German or French plus strong English skills, together with proficiency in Microsoft Office and an interest in using AI-enabled tools. A Swiss Certified Tax Expert diploma or equivalent tax qualification and additional languages are advantageous.

Education

University

Languages

English

About the company

At PwC Switzerland, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're part of a tech-forward, people-empowered network and help clients build, accelerate and sustain momentum across audit, assurance, tax, legal, workforce, deals and consulting.

This position administratively supports timely escrow closings and title recordings for transactions ranging from single site to high-liability multi-site commercial real estate transactions. What You’ll Do:

title: Infrastructure and Operations Team Lead (Remote in Canada)
description:
Company Overview

Intrahealth, a subsidiary of HEALWELL AI Inc. (TSX: AIDX), is an enterprise class EMR provider supporting approximately 20,000 providers and the care delivery of tens of millions of patients and clients across Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Intrahealth provides a suite of flexible software solutions to a wide variety of customers including health authorities, public health, community health, home care, and primary care professionals. Intrahealth’s solution is highly configurable and is ideal for complex health environments. To learn more about Intrahealth, please visit .

Position Overview

Intrahealth is hiring a full-time Infrastructure and Operations Team Lead. You will lead the team that hosts, runs, and secures our electronic medical record (EMR) software, for health authorities, public health agencies, community and home care organizations, and clinics across Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.

Our customers rely on our software to deliver care every day, so availability, performance, and security are essential. You will be accountable for the reliability of our hosted environments, lead a team of DevOps and operations specialists, and set the standards, tooling, and processes that keep production stable as we grow.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction and coach your team, and you will also design, build, and troubleshoot alongside them. You’ll work closely with colleagues in engineering, customer support, security, and compliance, and you’ll help shape our hosting strategy as it evolves.

Our hosted environments run in Microsoft Azure and AWS, using Kubernetes containers, PostgreSQL, Terraform for infrastructure as code, and GitHub for CI/CD. We operate under a quality and information security management system aligned with ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 13485, and SOC 2. We use AI tools to work more effectively, but every change to production follows our change control and verification standards.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of infrastructure, DevOps, and operations specialists, including hiring, onboarding, setting priorities, and managing performance.
  • Own the availability, performance, capacity, and cost of our hosted production and non-production environments.
  • Lead the response to infrastructure incidents, run post-incident reviews, and make sure lessons learned become lasting fixes.
  • Define service level objectives, and put monitoring and alerting in place so problems are found before customers notice them.
  • Maintain and improve infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation for Profile and related services.
  • Plan and deliver infrastructure projects, including new customer environments, upgrades, migrations, and changes to our hosting model.
  • Work with security and compliance colleagues to implement and evidence controls for ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, and customer contracts, and support internal and external audits.
  • Own backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and test them regularly.
  • Manage hosting and infrastructure suppliers, review cloud spending, and find opportunities to reduce cost.
  • Partner with engineering on release processes, environment needs, and production readiness for new services.
  • Act as an escalation point for customer support on hosting, performance, and connectivity issues.
  • Write and maintain runbooks, architecture documentation, and operational procedures.
  • Use AI tools to automate routine work and improve how the team operates.

Requirements

  • 8 or more years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or cloud operations, including at least 2 years leading or mentoring a technical team.
  • Deep, hands-on experience running customer-facing production workloads in Microsoft Azure, AWS, or both.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Strong scripting and automation skills in PowerShell, plus Bash or Python.
  • Experience running containerized applications on Kubernetes (such as AKS or EKS) and operating relational databases in production.
  • Solid knowledge of networking, identity and access management, and cloud security fundamentals.
  • A proven track record running incident management, change management, and on-call practices.
  • Experience working within a formal security or compliance framework, such as ISO/IEC 27001 or SOC 2, including producing audit evidence.
  • Ability to explain technical risks and trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues and leadership.
  • Sound judgment, a strong sense of ownership, and composure under pressure.
  • Willingness to use AI tools as part of daily work.
  • Legal entitlement to work in Canada, and the ability to obtain and maintain a Government of Canada security clearance.
  • Availability to take part in an on-call rotation and to work outside regular hours during incidents or planned maintenance.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in healthcare IT or with systems that handle personal health information.
  • Experience hosting SaaS for customers in more than one country, including data residency requirements in Canada, Australia, or New Zealand.
  • Experience with Windows Server, Linux, and PostgreSQL in production.
  • Relevant certifications, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or ITIL.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Azure Application Insights or Grafana.
  • Familiarity with Jira and Confluence.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is from $110,000 to $140,000.

Our salary ranges are designed to reflect the range of skills and experience needed for the position and to allow room for growth at Intrahealth. For experienced individuals, we typically hire at or around the midpoint of the range. The top portion of the salary range is reserved for employees who demonstrate sustained high performance and impact at Intrahealth. Those who are new to the role may join below the midpoint and develop their skills over time. The final offer amount for this role will be dependent on geographical region, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

Hiring Details

This posting is for a new position. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, tell us and we will work with you.

Note: Artificial intelligence tools may be used as part of the resume screening and candidate assessment process.

Intrahealth is committed to supporting a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome and celebrate the diversity of applicants and team members across ability, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, and perspective. We strive to create an inclusive workplace where differences are celebrated and fuel our success.

title: Head of Software
description:
About Silana

Silana builds robotic cells that sew garments end to end, starting from cut fabric panels and finishing with a sewn garment. We are a seed-stage team in New York and Vienna, deploying our first production cells with apparel brands and manufacturers in Europe and the US.

Each cell combines industrial robots, machine vision, PLC-controlled sewing machines and a learning-based manipulation stack. The software ties it all together, and it now has to go from prototype to something customers run in shifts.

The role

You will own Silana's software: its architecture, its quality and the people who build it. Today our software engineers work across robotics, vision, controls, embedded and machine learning, often in parallel tracks. Your job is to turn that into one coherent system and one aligned team.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll write and review code, make the key architecture calls, and lead a team of about 3–4 engineers. You'll work closely with the VP Eng and CTO on technical direction and with mechanical and electrical engineering on how the whole machine fits together.

What you'll do

Architecture

  • Own the software architecture of the cell: ROS 2 orchestration, behavior trees, machine vision, robot motion, PLC integration and learning-based manipulation.
  • Define clean interfaces and contracts between subsystems, so teams can work in parallel without breaking each other.
  • Make and document the key technical decisions: frameworks, build vs buy, data and logging strategy, how ML models get into production.

Team

  • Lead, hire and develop the software team across robotics, vision, controls, embedded and ML.
  • Keep everyone aligned on one roadmap and one way of working: planning, code review, testing and documentation standards. Enforce rigorous Test Driven Development practices.
  • Run 1:1s, give clear feedback, mentor and grow engineers along our leveling framework.

Hands-on

  • Write production code yourself, review the critical changes, and debug at the cell when it matters.
  • Build up the engineering foundation: CI/CD, automated and simulation testing, versioned releases, deployment and remote monitoring of cells at customer sites.
  • Take ownership of software reliability for production cells running in customer shifts.

What you bring

  • MS in Computer Science from a strong technical program
  • 5-8 years of direct professional experience in software engineering specifically for robotic applications, building deployed software for robots or other automated physical systems.
  • At least 3 years in a direct supervisory role over a small team of software engineers, with experience managing both waterfall and agile style projects.
  • You've taken a robotics system from prototype to deployment at customer sites and owned what happened when it broke there.
  • Deep experience with ROS or ROS 2 and C++ and Python on Linux.
  • Strong system-design skills: you can design across perception, motion, controls and hardware interfaces and explain the trade-offs simply.
  • You still like to code and are credible to senior engineers in code review.
  • You align people through clear writing, decisions and standards rather than authority alone.
  • Comfortable with startup ambiguity: changing priorities, hard deadlines and a machine that has to ship.

Nice to have

  • Experience with industrial automation: PLCs (Beckhoff/TwinCAT, EtherCAT), industrial robot 6-DOF arms such as Universal Robots, and safety-rated systems.
  • Machine vision or deep learning for manipulation, including getting learned policies (imitation learning, teleoperation data) into production.
  • Behavior trees (BehaviorTree.CPP), simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
  • Fleet operations: remote monitoring, release management, QA and support for machines at customer sites.

To apply, send your resume and a short note on a robotics system you architected: what you built, what broke in the field, and what you'd do differently.

title: Technical Lead, Consumer Pricing & Finance Programs
description:
Overview

Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Toyota. As one of the world’s most admired brands, Toyota is growing and leading the future of mobility through innovative, high-quality solutions designed to enhance lives and delight those we serve. While TFS is a separate business entity, it is an essential part of this world-changing company- delivering on Toyota's vision to move people beyond what's possible. At TFS, you will help create best-in-class customer experience in an innovative, collaborative environment.





Toyota does not offer support or sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based visas or any other work authorization for this role now or in the future. You must have the right to work in the United States and not require Toyota support or sponsorship for immigration-related employment (e.g., H-1B, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, TN, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, ‘job flexibility benefits’ [also known as I-140 or Adjustment of Status portability], etc.) now or in the future. You should not apply for this role if you will require Toyota to assist with immigration support or sponsorship now or in the future.


This position is based in Plano, TX.


Who We’re Looking For

Toyota Financial Services (TFS) is seeking an experienced Technical Lead to lead the Consumer Pricing & Finance Programs Factory within the Dealer Experience Technology Domain. This people leadership role is responsible for technology strategy, solution delivery, operational excellence, and team development across critical pricing, incentives, residual value, and finance program platforms supporting Toyota, Lexus, and partner finance organizations.


The portfolio includes consumer pricing and rate rules engine, Residuals, and Sales Tax Services, which support dealer origination, credit decisioning, and servicing processes.


As a hands-on leader ("player coach"), you'll guide a team of Software Engineers, Quality Analysts, and Business Systems Analysts while partnering with Product, Business, Data, and Architecture leaders to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions in a cloud-first (AWS) environment.

Technical Leadership & Solution Delivery

People Leadership

  • Coordinate and prioritize work across onshore, offshore, and vendor resources to meet business and technology objectives.

  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Demonstrated success defining technology roadmaps and delivering complex enterprise solutions using Agile methodologies.

  • Strong technical foundation in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, Angular (or similar front-end frameworks), SQL, and Python.
  • Experience translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions and successfully delivering large, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong stakeholder management, risk management, and problem-solving skills, with experience collaborating across product, business, architecture, security, operations, and engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence technical teams and effectively present to business and executive stakeholders.

Added Bonus If You Have
