  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile/Scrum or SAFe certification.
  • AWS and/or Google Cloud (GCP) certifications (e.g., Cloud Architect, Associate Cloud Engineer).
  • Experience within Banking / Financial Services / Captive Auto Finance, particularly consumer pricing, rate and incentive programs, credit risk, auto-decisioning or Enterprise Data Platforms.
  • Experience with BI and analytics tools (e.g., Amazon QuickSight) to build program and delivery dashboards.
  • Familiarity with Generative AI concepts and their application to engineering and business process automation.
  • Experience with Agile collaboration and task-management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) and ServiceNow.

What We’ll Bring

A few highlights include:

title: Registered Manager - Homecare
description:
Registered Manager – Homecare

£40,000 per year + Car Allowance* | Leamington Spa

Great care starts with a team that feels supported—and a manager who leads with purpose.

Are you an experienced Registered Manager looking for a fresh challenge and the opportunity to make a real difference?

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the service, develop your team and see the difference your leadership makes every day.

Why join The Care Bureau?

We’re an independently owned provider of homecare and support services, with more than 23 years of experience. Our ethos -Care for People, People for Care - reflects our commitment to the people we support and the colleagues who make that support possible.

We’re looking for a manager who shares that commitment and can turn it into consistent, high-quality care.

Your role

You’ll lead the day-to-day running of the branch, balancing excellent care, a well-supported workforce and a service that operates effectively.

Your priorities will include:

  • Leading with confidence: recruiting, supporting and developing a team that understands its responsibilities and feels proud of its work.
  • Making quality part of every day: maintaining CQC compliance through effective audits, clear action plans and continuous improvement.
  • Keeping people safe: overseeing safeguarding, incidents, complaints and duty of candour, and making sure learning leads to action.
  • Delivering person-centred care: ensuring care plans and risk assessments reflect each person’s needs, preferences and changing circumstances.
  • Running an effective service: overseeing rotas, staffing, training, absence, budgets and resources.
  • Building trusted relationships: working closely with clients, families, commissioners, social workers and healthcare professionals.

What you’ll bring

You’ll be an experienced Registered Manager, ready to take ownership and set clear standards.

We’re looking for:

  • Strong knowledge of CQC regulations and what they mean in everyday practice.
  • Proven leadership and people management skills.
  • Experience in care planning, risk management and delivering person-centred care.
  • Clear communication, sound judgement and strong organisational skills.
  • A practical approach to solving problems and improving services.
  • Flexibility to meet the needs of the service, including on-call duties.
  • A clean UK driving licence.

A Level 5 qualification in Leadership for Health and Social Care, or progress towards one, would be an advantage. We’d also welcome experience in domiciliary care, supported living or residential services, working with commissioners, and using care management software.

What we offer

  • £40,000 annual salary.
  • Car allowance, subject to location.
  • Statutory holiday entitlement and a workplace pension.
  • Access to the Blue Light Card discount scheme.
  • The opportunity to lead and shape a branch within an established, independently owned care provider.

Ready to make your next move?

If you care about getting the details right, supporting your team and delivering care people can rely on, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply through Indeed, or call our Recruitment Hotline on 0800 080 3035 to find out more.

Car allowance is subject to location.

title: Family Assistant Shelter Manager
company: Native American Youth and Family Center
description:
NAYA Family Center is seeking a compassionate, collaborative, and experienced khwat yaka haws (Auntie’s Place Family Shelter) Assistant Manager to support the daily operations and leadership of our family shelter serving Indigenous families experiencing homelessness. Working in partnership with the Family Shelter Manager, you’ll help create a safe, welcoming, and culturally grounded environment where families are treated with dignity, kindness, and respect. You’ll provide operational oversight, support and supervise shelter staff, help maintain effective shelter protocols, and ensure program data, reporting, and contract requirements are met. This role is an opportunity for a strong, supportive leader who understands the complexities of homelessness and is committed to creating a trauma-informed, accountable, and relationship-centered shelter environment.


NAYA offers medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 401(k) retirement plan with up to a 6% employer match; 16 paid holidays; and sick and vacation accrual, with vacation accrual increasing with tenure. General working hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 12:00 p.m.–9:00 p.m., with evenings and occasional weekends as assigned. This position participates in a rotating on-call schedule to provide shelter backup outside regular working hours, primarily by phone or text, with occasional in-person response as needed. The position is based in Milwaukie and Portland, Oregon, with approximately 90% of work time spent at the shelter or office and 10% outside the shelter, including travel. Compensation is $70,000–$75,000 annually.


Who You Are

  • You bring a combination of education and experience that provides the knowledge and skills needed to lead in a family shelter environment.
  • You have at least two years of experience providing direct services and/or supervising staff working with people experiencing homelessness or at risk of homelessness.
  • You have at least one year of experience managing or supervising team members, preferably in a housing or shelter setting, and can balance supportive leadership with accountability.
  • You understand the underlying issues impacting homelessness and poverty, along with trauma-informed care, nonviolent communication, and conflict resolution.
  • You have knowledge of Native American history, the diversity of the local American Indian/Alaska Native community, and issues surrounding the Urban Indian experience. Experience working with urban and reservation Native communities is strongly preferred.
  • You are familiar with local community resources, emergency services, and social service agencies, particularly those serving low-income and BIPOC communities.
  • You remain composed and exercise sound judgment in stressful situations, and understand the importance of staff wellness, self-care, and team retention in a demanding shelter environment.
  • You bring strong communication, active listening, organizational, and problem-solving skills, are comfortable with public presentations and computer-based data systems, and hold or can obtain and maintain CPR, First Aid, and AED certifications.


What You'll Do

  • Partner with the Family Shelter Manager to oversee daily shelter operations and ensure a safe, secure, welcoming, and culturally grounded environment for Indigenous families and shelter staff.
  • Support the development and implementation of shelter protocols and operating procedures aligned with funding requirements, NAYA's Relational Worldview Model, NAYA's 10 Core Values, Assertive Engagement, Housing First, and Harm Reduction.
  • Hire, train, support, and supervise shelter advocates in partnership with the Family Shelter Manager, including maintaining advocate schedules and providing guidance, accountability, and support to direct reports.
  • Promote a shelter environment where guests are treated with dignity, kindness, and respect while helping ensure shelter operations have minimal impact on the surrounding neighborhood.
  • Lead efforts to maintain accurate, timely participant data and reporting, including oversight of data quality and participation in Coordinated Housing Access (CHA), HMIS, and relevant networking meetings.
  • Support shelter operations and resource coordination, including room turnovers, offsite storage, food pickup, and organization of supplies to ensure families can access shelter as quickly as possible.
  • Assist with oversight and implementation of the approved shelter budget, track expenditures, maximize available resources, and serve as an alternate liaison with the property owner regarding facilities, maintenance, repairs, and security.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to respond to shelter emergencies and provide backup coverage, including staffing the shelter when necessary; coordinate wraparound services, maintain confidentiality, represent NAYA professionally, and participate in departmental and cross-departmental initiatives.


Application Instructions

Providing a cover letter helps us better understand your leadership experience, approach to staff supervision, and understanding of culturally responsive shelter services, as well as your interest in joining NAYA, so we encourage you to submit one along with your resume. If you need accommodation during the application process, please email jobs@nayapdx.org.


Questions? Want to learn more about this opportunity before applying? We'd be happy to connect you with our Housing and Stabilization Services leadership team or Human Resources.


NAYA is committed to building a work environment that respects and inspires every community member. Our mission is to serve Urban Native youth and families, so we strongly encourage members of the Native community to apply. We encourage applications from members of other historically marginalized groups as well, including women, people of color, those with disabilities, members of the LGBTQ+ community, and those who have served in the military.

title: Senior Project Manager (Architect)
description:
About MKThink

MKThink is a future-forward design firm grounded in spatial intelligence and dedicated to “build less, solve more.” Our data-informed solutions improve human performance at lower operational, environmental, and capital costs than conventional approaches. Founded in 2000, MKThink practices from the Pacific Edge of San Francisco to the Oceanic Edge of O’ahu. At MKThink, we believe that we can play a role in helping create a better and more sustainable future by creating intelligent spaces that improve the quality of life. Our greatest resource is our staff and their ability to contribute fully as teammates and individuals. We bring together thinkers from various disciplines to solve problems at the nexus of architecture, culture, and the environment. Our people have the interdisciplinary skills to contribute to this mission within and across the domains of architecture, strategies, and innovation.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Project Manager to run architectural projects from proposal through closeout or serve as an owner’s representative. Our work includes education, civic, healthcare, commercial, multifamily, and mixed-use projects.

You’ll be responsible for scope, schedule, fee, and staffing on your projects. You’ll be the main contact for clients and consultants, and you’ll lead the team through drawing production and construction administration.

You need to be a licensed architect with a minimum of 10-15 years of experience. Experience with California, Hawaii, or Pacific Island jurisdictions, public agencies, and DSA or HCAI review is a big plus. We also do strategy and advisory work, so this is a good fit if you want to work beyond traditional design delivery.

Responsibilities

Clients and consultants

  • Be the main contact for clients from kickoff through closeout
  • Run client meetings and presentations
  • Manage consultant teams, including engineers, specialty consultants, and contractors
  • Handle permitting and agency coordination, including DSA or HCAI review when it applies
  • On owner’s representative projects, act for the client in managing the design team, contractor, schedule, and budget

Planning, budgets, and staffing

  • Write project work plans and fee budgets
  • Staff projects and track hours and progress against the budget
  • Build and maintain the project schedule
  • Watch scope, raise changes early, and write up additional services when needed
  • Lead value engineering with the client, consultants, and contractor

Drawing sets

  • Oversee drawing set production in every phase and check sets for quality and coordination
  • Set Revit standards for your projects and solve documentation problems
  • Oversee code and accessibility reviews

Construction administration

  • Run CA: submittals, shop drawings, RFIs, site visits, punch lists, and closeout
  • Work through construction issues with the contractor and consultants
  • Keep the drawings current with field changes

New work

  • Lead RFP and RFQ responses, including scope, fee, schedule, and team
  • Take part in client interviews

Team

  • Mentor project architects and junior staff

Qualifications

Required

  • Licensed architect
  • Minimum of 10-15 years of architecture experience, including time managing projects
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Architecture from an accredited program
  • Construction administration experience through closeout
  • Experience writing work plans, fee budgets, schedules, and staffing plans
  • Strong drawing set production skills and advanced Revit knowledge
  • Experience leading client communication and consultant coordination
  • Value engineering experience
  • Experience writing RFP and RFQ responses
  • Solid knowledge of building codes, accessibility, construction methods, and building systems
  • Clear writing and speaking

Preferred

  • Hawaii or California license
  • Projects in Hawaii, California, or the Pacific Islands, including public agency permitting
  • DSA or HCAI experience
  • Education, healthcare, civic, or mixed-use experience
  • Spec writing
  • LEED AP or WELL AP, or experience with sustainable building
  • Interest in data-driven design, stakeholder engagement, and AI tools
  • Curiosity about how space affects performance, behavior, and outcomes
  • Interest in working across disciplines, combining design, data, and systems thinking
  • Drive to have an impact at the organizational or societal scale
  • Strong technical problem-solving skills
  • Self-motivation and adaptability on fast-moving projects
  • Commitment to design excellence, innovation, and continuous learning
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize well, and ask for help when needed
  • AI tools, Bluebeam, Rhino, Enscape, and Adobe Creative Cloud

Location

We strongly prefer candidates who live in Hawaii or are willing to move there. If you’re not in Hawaii, you need to be in San Francisco and work from our San Francisco office.

How to Apply

Go to mkthink.com/contact and select this posting. Send a cover letter and one PDF with your resume and work samples that show projects you’ve led.

title: Middle Manual QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle Manual QA Engineer based in Switzerland.

This role offers the opportunity to strengthen quality assurance for an established enterprise web application preparing for a major framework modernization. You will take ownership of building a reliable regression testing approach, ensuring that critical business workflows and existing application behavior remain consistent throughout the transition. Working closely with developers, product stakeholders, and the customer’s team, you will investigate application functionality, uncover undocumented business rules, and design thorough test scenarios. The position is primarily focused on manual testing, API validation, and exploratory testing, with opportunities to introduce basic automated checks using AI-assisted tools. You will also contribute to release readiness, documentation, and continuous improvement in a collaborative engineering environment.

Accountabilities

  • Own the regression testing strategy: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve a structured regression testing approach for the existing enterprise application.
  • Analyze business workflows: Collaborate with the customer’s team to investigate, reverse-engineer, and document critical business processes and user scenarios.
  • Explore application functionality: Identify key features, edge cases, undocumented business rules, and areas of potential risk within the existing system.
  • Design comprehensive test scenarios: Create regression, characterization (golden master), and exploratory test cases before significant system changes or modernization activities.
  • Perform manual testing: Execute functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and release validation checks to verify application behavior and identify defects.
  • Validate APIs and HTTP interactions: Conduct manual API and HTTP testing to confirm the reliability of critical application functionality and workflows.
  • Introduce basic automation: Work with engineers and AI-assisted tools to develop simple automated checks for selected high-priority workflows and APIs.
  • Support CI/CD integration: Help incorporate automated checks into Azure DevOps pipelines and review execution results.
  • Contribute to release quality: Perform security-related checks and support release cycles by identifying and communicating potential issues.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing: Assist the customer with UAT activities, helping validate that application functionality meets business expectations.
  • Investigate defects: Analyze test failures, application logs, and stack traces to help identify potential causes and communicate findings to developers.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams: Work with developers and the Product Owner to clarify requirements, investigate unexpected behavior, and resolve ambiguities.
  • Maintain QA documentation: Keep test cases, regression suites, test results, and other quality assurance documentation clear, organized, and up to date.

Requirements

  • Professional experience: At least 4 years of experience in manual quality assurance or software testing, primarily involving web applications or backend systems.
  • Testing fundamentals: Strong understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality assurance methodologies.
  • Regression testing expertise: Practical experience designing and maintaining regression test suites, smoke tests, sanity checks, and release validation criteria.
  • Business analysis and risk assessment: Ability to independently understand business workflows, identify potential risks, and translate requirements into clear, effective test cases.
  • Exploratory and API testing: Hands-on experience with exploratory testing and API validation.
  • Web and HTTP knowledge: Good understanding of HTTP fundamentals, cookies, sessions, and typical web application architecture.
  • API testing tools: Practical experience using tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or curl.
  • CI/CD and Azure DevOps: Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Azure DevOps (ADO), including executing existing jobs, reviewing pipeline results, and investigating failures.
  • Technical troubleshooting: Basic familiarity with application logs, stack traces, and build tools.
  • Communication and documentation: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document findings clearly and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • English proficiency: Upper-Intermediate level of English or higher.

Nice To Have

  • Test automation: Basic automation experience or a willingness to learn and introduce simple automated checks with support from AI-assisted tools.
  • Java testing frameworks: Familiarity with JUnit, TestNG, Selenium, Selenide, or REST Assured.
  • AI-assisted development: Experience with tools such as GitHub Copilot to generate basic test scripts or test skeletons, together with the ability to review and validate generated code.
  • Modernization projects: Experience testing applications during framework upgrades, platform modernization, or backend migrations.
  • Characterization testing: Familiarity with golden master testing or other techniques for comparing application behavior before and after changes.
  • Legacy Java environments: Experience with legacy Java applications, Apache Tomcat, or servlet-based systems.
  • Web technologies: Familiarity with XML, XSLT, or server-side rendering technologies.
  • Application security: Basic understanding of application security principles and common OWASP vulnerabilities.

Benefits

  • Flexible working arrangements: Choice of remote, office-based, or flexible working formats.
  • Competitive compensation: Competitive salary and compensation package.
  • Career development: Personalized career growth opportunities.
  • Professional development: Access to mentorship, technical talks, training programs, and centers of excellence.
  • Knowledge sharing: Active technical communities and opportunities to exchange expertise with colleagues.
  • Education support: Education reimbursement.
  • Recognition: Memorable gifts for work anniversaries.
  • Team activities: Corporate events and team-building activities.
  • Additional benefits: Other location-specific benefits may be available.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Associate Director, Medical Affairs Strategy, Oncology, France
description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.


Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.


Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!


The Role

The Associate Director, Medical Affairs Strategy, Oncology will lead the medical strategy and tactical planning for assigned assets or therapeutic areas within France, translating European and global priorities into plans that address local scientific needs.


Reporting to the Country Medical Director, the role will lead asset-level medical launch readiness, identify local evidence needs and coordinate cross-functional delivery of the medical plan. The incumbent will work closely with the MSL team to ensure effective field execution and that insights from external engagement inform medical priorities.


Within the operating model, the Country Medical Director owns the overall country medical strategy, organisation and budget. The Associate Director leads strategy for assigned assets or therapeutic areas.


Key Responsibilities


Medical Strategy and Planning

  • Develop and deliver country medical strategic and tactical plans for assigned assets, aligned with European and global priorities.
  • Translate scientific insights, unmet needs and evidence gaps into clear objectives, activities and measures of impact.
  • Serve as the medical subject matter expert on relevant cross-functional brand and launch teams.
  • Work with Clinical Development, Regulatory, Market Access and Commercial colleagues to contribute medical input to launch and lifecycle planning.
  • Develop activity budgets and manage approved expenditure under the oversight of the Country Medical Director.
  • Partner with European/Global Medical Affairs Strategy Leads to ensure alignment and communicate country priorities.

Medical Launch Readiness and Execution

  • Lead pre-launch, launch and post-launch medical planning and readiness for assigned assets.
  • Coordinate delivery of medical activities, including advisory boards, scientific education, congress plans and medical materials.
  • Partner with the MSL team to translate medical strategy into field plans and provide the scientific direction and resources needed for execution.
  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs Training to support scientific readiness across relevant teams.
  • Monitor progress against agreed objectives and adapt plans in response to insights, emerging data and changing needs.

Evidence Planning and Clinical Development Input

  • Lead the identification and prioritisation of country evidence needs and contribute these to European and global evidence-generation plans.
  • Partner with Global evidence-generation teams on the design and delivery of agreed initiatives, within established governance.
  • Provide country medical input into global clinical development strategy, study design and feasibility.
  • Support locally led studies where agreed, with responsibilities defined through the relevant governance.
  • Evaluate and facilitate investigator-sponsored research proposals through established review processes.

Scientific Engagement and Insights

  • Build relationships with relevant thought leaders, investigators, scientific societies and patient advocacy organisations.
  • Lead strategic scientific engagement to understand clinical practice, unmet needs and evidence gaps.
  • Act as a scientific expert at advisory boards, congresses and other appropriate forums.
  • Integrate field insights with other scientific and healthcare-system information to inform medical decisions.

Governance and Collaboration

  • Ensure scientific accuracy, balance and alignment of medical materials with global and local strategy.
  • Contribute to material review and approval within assigned responsibilities and local requirements.
  • Collaborate with Medical Information, Pharmacovigilance, Legal, Compliance and Regulatory colleagues.
  • Ensure all activities follow applicable requirements, industry codes and Genmab policies.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree in medicine, pharmacy or life sciences, such as an MD, PharmD or PhD.
  • At least 8+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, Clinical Development or a related role.
  • Relevant oncology experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing and executing medical plans; launch experience preferred.
  • Strong scientific expertise and ability to critically interpret clinical data.
  • Understanding of the local healthcare system, treatment pathways and payer landscape.
  • Significant experience working on clinical trial methodology and conduct of registries, early access programs and IST programs in oncology
  • Experience working effectively across local, regional and global teams.
  • Strong planning, communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Fluency in English and French

Competencies and Attributes

  • Strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate priorities into practical plans.
  • Scientific curiosity and a patient-focused approach.
  • Collaborative working style and ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Sound judgement, integrity and accountability.
  • Ability to prioritise and adapt within a growing organisation.

Location and Travel

Based in France, with regular office presence (typically three days per week) and domestic and international travel for scientific engagement, congresses and internal collaboration.


The proposed gross annual base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

EUR85.600,00---128.400,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Pension
  • Health insurance and wellness benefits
  • Paid time off
  • Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.



About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.


Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.


Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).


Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the contract.

title: Senior/Principal AI Engineer, Agentic Systems, AI for Drug Discovery
description:
The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide. ​



The Opportunity


Within AI for Drug Discovery, our team builds platforms that bring AI agents, machine learning models, scientific tools, and data into the hands of drug discovery scientists. We are seeking a Senior / Principal AI Engineer to own the backend architecture of our agentic molecule design platform and help turn emerging AI and scientific capabilities into robust, production-quality systems. At the Senior level, you will lead delivery of major platform workstreams. At the Principal level, you will also own the platform's technical direction and outcomes, and lead across teams.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of backend systems, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and computational drug discovery. You will work closely with software engineers, machine learning engineers, computational scientists, and experimental scientists to build reliable foundations for agentic scientific workflows.


In this role, you will:


  • Own and evolve the backend architecture of the agentic molecule design platform, including service boundaries, APIs, persistence, workflow state, asynchronous execution, and integration patterns.
  • Scale the platform for its projected user base: stateless services, session and workflow state, load and capacity testing, running multiple replicas reliably.
  • Design reliable infrastructure for long-running scientific and agentic workflows, including retries, checkpointing, idempotency, failure recovery, and human-in-the-loop interactions.
  • Build backend services that integrate AI agents, scientific tools, machine learning models, databases, and internal services into end-to-end workflows.
  • Evaluate new AI agents using our agentic evaluation framework, decide with scientists which are worth deploying, and bring them into production safely via sandboxing, scoped permissions, monitoring, and rollback.
  • Establish strong engineering practices around testing, observability, reliability, performance, deployment, and operational ownership.
  • Lead delivery of major platform workstreams: translate project goals into concrete outcomes, and manage dependencies, risks, and stakeholder alignment with ML, data, and scientific teams.

  • For the Principal AI Engineer level:
    • Own technical direction and outcomes for the platform as a whole: scope, priorities, trade-offs and risks. Be the group's go-to decision maker on architecture and delivery.
    • Lead across team boundaries (including ML, data, foundation models, and scientific teams) to align shared infrastructure, including the job-execution layers and agentic platforms our applications depend on.
    • Set engineering standards and reusable components that other teams adopt, and mentor senior engineers.

Who You Are


  • You have significant experience building and owning production backend, platform, or distributed systems, with a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (typically BS + 4-7 years, MS + 3-5 years, or PhD + 0-2 years of relevant experience).
  • You are a strong Python engineer with deep software engineering fundamentals, including system design, APIs, distributed systems, data modeling, testing, and maintainable architecture.
  • You have experience designing systems with asynchronous workflows, persistent state, failure handling, and clear service boundaries.
  • You have migrated a production system to a new framework or backend while minimizing downtime.
  • You have scaled a service horizontally and have navigated failure modes around in-memory state, sticky sessions, background workers, DB connections.
  • You understand the practical requirements of production AI-enabled applications, including observability, evaluation, deployment, reliability, and iteration.
  • You can translate ambiguous product or scientific requirements into pragmatic technical architectures and implementation plans.
  • You have led delivery of complex workstreams and can coach other engineers.

  • For the Principal AI Engineer level:
    • Typically BS + 7-12 years, MS + 5-10 years, or PhD + 2-7 years of relevant experience.
    • A track record of owning architecture and outcomes for a complex, multi-team platform, and of being the person others go to for technical decisions.
    • You have strong working knowledge of LLMs and agentic frameworks, including evaluation and model validation practices, and the guardrails needed to run autonomous agents safely.
    • Influence beyond your own team: shaping shared standards, guiding architectural decisions, and mentoring senior engineers.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience building AI- or ML-enabled applications, agentic systems, or platforms that integrate models, tools, and data.
  • Experience with agent orchestration, tool calling, state management, human-in-the-loop workflows, retrieval, tracing, and Model Context Protocol.
  • Experience with model serving, scientific computing workloads, workflow engines, event-driven architectures, queues, or distributed job-execution systems.
  • Experience designing data platforms that combine raw data, derived features, model outputs, metadata, provenance, and large computational artifacts.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, Helm, load testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and production observability.
  • Experience in computational biology, bioinformatics, cheminformatics, computational chemistry, protein engineering, drug discovery, or another scientific computing domain.
  • Experience running untrusted or model-generated code safely (sandboxing, container isolation, least-privilege service accounts).
  • Deep experience with multi-agent orchestration, including evaluation frameworks and guardrails.

Relocation benefits are NOT available for this job posting


The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of California, is $168,100 - 312,300 for the Senior AI Engineer and $201,300 - 373,800 for the Principal AI Engineer. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering


  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP.
  • Manage AWS services including EC2, EKS, ECS, IAM, VPC, S3, Route 53, CloudWatch, and related networking and security services.
  • Work with GCP services including Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC networking, and Cloud Monitoring.
  • Develop reusable infrastructure modules and standardized deployment patterns using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Automate cloud account and project provisioning, resource configuration, access management, governance, and compliance.
  • Build and refine internal cloud platform functions that empower engineering teams to provision and manage infrastructure through self-service workflows.

Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Infrastructure


  • Deploy, manage, and optimize Kubernetes clusters across Amazon EKS and Google GKE.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-based platforms supporting containerized applications and microservices.
  • Implement container orchestration, workload scaling, cluster upgrades, resource optimization, and security guidelines.
  • Develop reusable Helm charts and deployment configurations to standardize application delivery.
  • Troubleshoot Kubernetes networking, scheduling, performance, and reliability issues.

Infrastructure Automation & Developer Productivity


  • Develop automation tools and services using Python, Go, Bash, or comparable programming languages.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar technologies.
  • Integrate infrastructure automation into internal engineering platforms and developer workflows.
  • Build APIs, command-line utilities, and automation frameworks to reduce manual operational work.
  • Improve developer experience by simplifying infrastructure provisioning, deployment, and operational workflows.
  • Partner with engineering teams to find opportunities for platform standardization and automation.

Reliability, Observability & Operations


  • Implement Site Reliability Engineering approaches to boost platform availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, metrics, and alerting through Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, and associated observability technologies.
  • Define and improve service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and operational health metrics.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex problems related to infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes, and distributed systems.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvements.
  • Find opportunities to improve cloud cost efficiency, resource utilization, and infrastructure performance.

Security, Governance & Collaboration


  • Implement cloud security guidelines, including IAM, least-privilege access, network segmentation, secrets management, and encryption.
  • Support cloud governance and compliance through automated rules and infrastructure standards.
  • Work closely with software engineers, security teams, SREs, and infrastructure groups to provide dependable cloud platforms.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, technical design reviews, code reviews, and platform roadmap planning.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge sharing.

What You Bring


Required Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or a related engineering field.
  • Solid practical experience with AWS and/or GCP, including the capability to design, deploy, and manage production cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience managing Kubernetes environments, preferably Amazon EKS and/or Google GKE.
  • Solid expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code methods.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, Git-centered workflows, and automated infrastructure rollouts.
  • Skilled in Python, Go, Bash, or comparable languages for infrastructure automation and tooling.
  • Strong understanding of Linux systems, cloud networking, DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, routing, and security fundamentals.
  • Experience with Docker, containers, and cloud-native application deployment patterns.
  • Experience with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, or Google Cloud Monitoring.
  • Understanding of SRE principles, incident management, troubleshooting, and production reliability.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities related to cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities, capable of working effectively with engineering and infrastructure teams.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Practical experience managing infrastructure on both AWS and GCP within large-scale enterprise settings.
  • Experience developing internal developer platforms, self-service infrastructure, or cloud provisioning frameworks.
  • Experience automating AWS account provisioning, GCP project provisioning, IAM governance, and cloud compliance.
  • Experience with Kubernetes GitOps solutions like Argo CD or Flux.
  • Experience with Helm, Ansible, and reusable infrastructure automation frameworks.
  • Understanding of cloud security, policy-as-code, secrets management, and enterprise governance approaches.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, and FinOps principles.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML cloud services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI.
  • Experience providing support for enterprise engineering tools like GitHub Enterprise, Artifactory, SonarQube, JIRA, or Confluence.
  • Experience developing internal APIs, microservices, or platform tooling using Go, Python, or Java.
  • Familiarity with hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud architecture and operations.

title: Planning and Controls Manager
description:
Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and maintenance services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 25,500 employees operate across over 70 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. From motorways to tramways, water and wastewater treatment to smart cities, clients choose us to help them solve their most complex challenges and to deliver climate responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry and the planet.

About Egis in Ireland

Egis has operated in Ireland since 1994 and is one of the largest multi-disciplinary consultancy, engineering and operations firms in the country. Our services in Ireland span the full lifespan of infrastructure, from upstream feasibility studies through design, construction supervision, delivery and operations. Operating across the entire value chain of consulting, design and operation, Egis is the only group to understand infrastructure in its entirety. Our current activities in Ireland include operating the Dublin Tunnel and the Jack Lynch Tunnel in Cork, overseeing 470km of Ireland’s motorways and working on the design and delivery of major transport projects and mobility services.

With over 600 staff in Ireland across 16 offices nationwide, we are committed to enabling sustainable economic development and responding to the requirements of population growth while addressing climate change and reducing carbon emissions.

In 2023 Egis acquired JB Barry & Partners, an engineering firm which has worked on major projects such as the Ringsend Wastewater Treatment Plant in Dublin and the N17/N18 Gort to Tuam PPP motorway scheme in Galway. The Egis engineering division is now almost 200 people strong across four offices in Dublin, Castlebar, Cork and Limerick.

We work in partnership with public sector clients and private companies both at home and internationally, and we are committed to supporting the government in realising their climate, infrastructural and societal goals as part of Project Ireland 2040

Our key areas of expertise in Civil Engineering include:

  • Rail & Urban transit
  • Active travel
  • Roads and bridges
  • Water & Wastewater
  • Smart cities
  • Energy
  • Consulting and Operations


Job Description

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our growing team as a Planning Manager at Egis. The Planner is responsible for carrying out planning management duties across a range of Egis projects in Ireland in our transportation team.

The role will be responsible for leading the planning function, developing and maintaining robust control of project programme. This includes providing active support to the project and programme team in all planning and reporting activities. This role would suit a collaborative individual with great leadership and communication skills who enjoys multi-tasking, loves a busy working environment and thrives under pressure.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support the planning team ensuring everyone is working in a positive environment, requirements are clear and goals are achievable.
  • Assess the Planning team needs and upskill when required to ensure effective delivery and optimum performance.
  • Understand clarify and implement the requirements of the Subcontract Works Information related to project controls. Demonstrate compliance to the standards by providing evidence during audits and protecting against breaches.
  • Responsible for the development, update and maintenance of the programmes.
  • Maintain a positive relationship with the client’s planning team to ensure programme aligned to the contract and is accepted at all times.
  • Manage the programme interface with other work packages by identifying key milestones and align with access dates.
  • Ensure that the programme comments raised by the client are reviewed, actions are validated and resubmission is made after closing out the comments.
  • Support the commercial team in developing CE quotations by providing programmes and support the Bottom up Forecasts by providing labour and expenditure profiles.
  • Ensure key compensation events, Contractor Instructions and Early Warnings are modelled in the programme promptly by maintaining daily check-ins on CEMAR.
  • Manage the programme communications, ensure any critical changes are promptly relayed to internal stakeholders and external stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ensure the programme aligns with the project leadership’s defined goals, including delivery approach and Compensation Events strategies.
  • Ensure any movement in Planned Completion and / or Key Dates Planned Completion is well documented and the underlying reasons for the variance are substantiated.
  • Ensure appropriate Time Risk Allowance (TRA) is allocated to the critical activities and maintain transparency in reporting and ownership of TRA.
  • Responsible for integrating Commercial and Planning for aspects related to Earned Value Analysis (EVA), including:
      1. Spend profile,
      2. Earned Value
      3. Planned Value
      4. Schedule Performance Index (SPI)
  • Responsible for tracking quantities of materials and reporting planned, actuals and forecast.
  • Liaise with Construction team on a daily basis to ensure robust project reporting is in place; integrate daily shift reports into the programme to ensure efficient delivery and realistic timescales.
  • Liaise with the Procurement team to ensure the Tender Event Schedule (TES) is synced with the latest programme. Align construction sequencing with procurement lead times and material delivery schedules.


Qualifications

  • Previous experience in Transportation, Infrastructure or Civil Engineering projects
  • Significant experience in a project planning position
  • Excellent knowledge of planning software
  • Proficiency in Primavera P6 and MS Project is essential.
  • Other scheduling software experience is a plus.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering major projects within a contractor environment.
  • Excellent people management and development skills
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and client management abilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to travel as required for project assignments.
  • Excellent time management, prioritisation, and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Strong attention to detail, quality focus, and methodical working style.
  • Adaptability in a dynamic environment with a proactive, ‘can-do’ attitude.

Desirable :

  • Degree in Project Management, Engineering or a related field
  • Chartered project manager or similar and member of a related professional body


Additional Information

Additional Information

Flexibility to based in any of our Ireland offices: Dublin, Cork, Castlebar or Limerick

Why join Egis?

Joining Egis means, above all, sharing our values as a people-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation and determined to address today’s biggest challenges: fighting climate change, facilitating the digital transition and meeting the needs of growing populations.

In Ireland, Egis is delivering some of the most iconic projects, from motorways to tunnels, water and energy services, via rail to cyber, designing smart, green infrastructure, transport and buildings, connecting people and creating a sustainable future for communities everywhere.

We are passionate about solving our clients’ most complex challenges by delivering climate-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industries and the planet.

Local experience backed by global reach

Egis engineering foundation and pedigree is in JB Barry's local legacy. Generations of engineers have passed through our doors, and our standing among Irish clients has been established over decades. We have been behind some of Ireland’s iconic infrastructure with specialisms including water & energy, structures and transportation. Now we’re part of Egis we have access to global talent, teams and technologies. A career with us can lead to opportunities to travel and experience some of our work in over 70 countries

Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

We at EGIS are an Equal Opportunities employer and we recognise the value of a Diverse Organisation. EGIS appreciates all job applications. If you decide to apply for an opportunity at EGIS, your application will be assessed based purely on your experience, the essential and desirable criteria, and your suitability for the role. We value each and everyone’s contribution as this builds our culture and means, if you work for EGIS, you will be included, listened to, and respected.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Are you an experienced Solution Architect? Have you taken charge of the redesign and rearchitecture of large monolithic applications into microservices? Have you provided development teams with direction and architectural decisions in an Agile way? You will join a specialist Architecture team based in Zurich that take responsibility for API development. Alongside the developers in Zurich, there is also a near shore team that contribute to the ongoing development and growth of the platform. The team have developed an integration platform that enables developers to develop their own microservices and currently have circa 60 microservices in production.


They do this by following a strict Agile approach to development, making use of high test coverage and also Cucumber for BDD. Given the nature of their work, there is containerization using Docker & Kubernetes. Join a global team of almost 1200 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond when things go wrong. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology service solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting, and enabling the business through secure solutions and information systems.

The Opportunity

As a Security Data Engineer within Security Technology Services (STS), you will join a global team responsible for engineering, integrating and enhancing security data platforms that support EY’s multi-cloud and on-premises environments.

You will develop scalable data ingestion, integration, automation and analytics capabilities that provide centralized visibility across multiple security, and operational technology platforms. Working across Azure, you will use modern cloud-native services and ETL frameworks to onboard, transform, enrich and analyze enterprise data.

The role will also design and support Azure-based data pipelines, automation solutions and reporting capabilities using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and SQL technologies to improve operational efficiency, data quality and decision-making.

You will support the implementation and ongoing management of SaaS applications and enterprise security technologies used by Information Security teams globally. This includes partnering with Security Architects, Service Delivery, Security Operations, Engineering teams and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable and data-driven solutions, while providing technical guidance for complex integrations.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Design build and maintain enterprise-scale ETL/ELT processes and Azure data integration frameworks across multiple cloud environments (primarily Azure) from both security and enterprise tools
  • Build and support data ingestion, orchestration and automation solutions using Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Logic Apps and related Azure services.
  • Collect, transform, validate, enrich and analyze data from enterprise systems, cloud platforms, APIs, SaaS applications and third-party technologies.
  • Develop SQL-based data pipelines, database objects, stored procedures, data models, dashboards and reporting solutions for business, compliance and security needs.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to onboard data sources and deliver scalable integration, automation, reporting and analytics capabilities.
  • Support enterprise data platforms through performance tuning, troubleshooting, monitoring, automation, upgrades, cloud migration, change management and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, support runbooks and data flow documentation.
  • Work across multi-cloud environments with Microsoft Azure as the primary platform

The successful candidate will have:

  • Experience with Azure Databricks, data warehousing, data lake architecture and Azure native data platforms for large-scale transformation and analytics.
  • Exposure to Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSDT, SSRS, SSIS, relational databases, stored procedures and reporting frameworks.
  • Experience developing REST API integrations and consuming web services for enterprise data onboarding and automation.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud automation and deployment automation practices.
  • Experience with, integrating large amounts of security data across multiple cloud environments (primarily Azure) from both security and non-security tools.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and alerting for cloud services, data pipelines, integrations and automation workflows.
  • Knowledge and exposure to Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI a plus.

Skills and Attributes for Success

We are looking for individuals with practical experience working as a Data Engineer in a large Azure global environment with strong knowledge in analytics and reporting

The successful candidate will have:

  • Strong understanding of data engineering principles, including ETL/ELT, data modelling, transformation, lifecycle management, master data management, data warehousing, data lakes and enterprise data architecture.
  • Experience designing scalable, resilient and secure Azure-native data ingestion, integration, automation, analytics and reporting solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Storage Accounts, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Azure App Services and related integration services.
  • Strong SQL and data analysis experience across relational databases, SQL Server technologies, stored procedures, reporting frameworks and analytics platforms.
  • Ability to work with structured, semi-structured and API-driven data from cloud platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise systems and security technologies.
  • Proficiency in Python, PowerShell or similar scripting languages for automation, cloud operations, data transformation, monitoring and systems integration.
  • Strong understanding of Azure cloud security concepts including identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, authentication, authorization, secure API integration and governance.
  • Experience developing automated workflows that improve efficiency, data quality, compliance monitoring, platform resilience and service reliability.
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices including CI/CD, source control, deployment automation, environment management and release processes.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills across cloud platforms, databases, APIs, data pipelines, automation workflows and enterprise applications.
  • Experience integrating large amounts of data from various SaaS and OnPrem platforms and tools into centralized platforms for reporting, analytics, governance and decision-making.
  • Ability to collaborate across engineering, infrastructure, operations, security, architecture and business teams to deliver end-to-end technical solutions.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and consulting skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation, optimization, operational excellence and emerging cloud technologies.
  • Knowledge and exposure to Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI a plus.
  • Knowledge of creating and maintaining Power BI dashboards/reports.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

  • Detailed knowledge of Azure cloud data engineering, enterprise integrations, data platforms, database technologies, networking fundamentals, API-based architectures and scripting languages.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, SQL development, ETL/ELT frameworks, data integration patterns, cloud automation and enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Experience designing, supporting and troubleshooting enterprise-scale cloud data platforms, integrations and analytics solutions for operational, compliance or security use cases.
  • At least 8 years of experience in Data Engineering,
  • 3+ years of demonstrated engineering experience in large, global and virtual enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of Azure cloud technologies, enterprise integrations, and data architecture.
  • Excellent time management, organizational and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to document processes, procedures, architecture designs, data flows and technical solutions clearly for internal teams and customers.
  • Experience working with external vendors and suppliers across technology services.
  • Technical proficiency with APIs, automation frameworks and scripting technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Ansible or similar platforms.

Ideally, You’ll Also Have

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Microsoft Azure or technology certification programs.
  • Experience in project management, service introduction, service readiness, and technology lifecycle management.

What We Look For

This role is ideal for someone with strong problem-solving, analytical, decision-making and communication skills.

We are looking for individuals who work effectively with culturally diverse onshore and offshore teams, navigate ambiguity with confidence and balance security, cloud engineering, data engineering and operational priorities.

Independent thinkers with strong technical foundations, collaborative mindsets and a commitment to automation and continuous improvement will thrive in this role.

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial, and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:

  • Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  • Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
  • Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  • Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer, and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
Job Posting ID: KT_277_JOB

Position: Cybersecurity Analyst

Clearance: Must be able to obtain a Public Trust / Active Secret clearance preferred. US Citizens only.

FT/PT Status: Full-Time

Location: Remote, must reside within VA, DC, MD, TX, GA, FL

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.


Overview:
Kreative Technologies is in search of a Cybersecurity Analyst to support security compliance and risk management for federal systems. The Cybersecurity Analyst will support assessment and authorization (A&A) activities under FedRAMP, CMMC and the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), maintain security documentation, and help system owners identify and fix security risks. The ideal candidate communicates clearly with technical teams, management, and government personnel, and can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Support A&A activities under FedRAMP, CMMC and the NIST RMF to help federal systems obtain and maintain an Authority to Operate (ATO).
  • Develop and maintain security documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), FIPS 199 categorizations, risk assessments, contingency plans and Security Assessment Reports.
  • Track and manage Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), working with system owners to resolve findings on schedule.
  • Assess security controls against NIST SP 800-53 and document the results.
  • Review vulnerability scan results, analyze risks and recommend fixes.
  • Support continuous monitoring by tracking control status, vulnerabilities and system changes.
  • Prepare and review privacy documents, including Privacy Threshold Analyses (PTAs) and Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), as needed.
  • Upload and maintain security artifacts in GRC tools such as [eMASS / Xacta / CSAM].
  • Support FISMA reporting, audits, and data calls.
  • Identify, report, and help resolve security incidents and policy violations.
  • Advise system owners, ISSOs, and government stakeholders on security requirements and best practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3–5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information assurance or security compliance.
  • Hands-on experience with NIST RMF and NIST SP 800-53 security controls.
  • Experience developing A&A documentation and managing POA&Ms.
  • One or more of the certifications listed: CompTIA Security+, CASP+, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CAP/CGRC, or GSEC
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including documenting findings clearly for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting federal civilian or DoD agencies as a contractor.
  • Experience with GRC tools such as eMASS, Xacta or CSAM.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning tools such as Tenable/Nessus, Qualysor ACAS.
  • Familiarity with FedRAMP, FISMA and privacy requirements.

Compensation: $92,000 - $102,000 yearly


Kreative Technologies is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We celebrate the unique differences of our employees because that is what drives curiosity, innovation, and the success of our business. Kreative Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities.

title: Project Manager, Developer - Cork

Residential, Apartments and refurb

Degree qualified in Civil engineer, construction manager or related field

Previous experience with a developer or main contractor

Previous residential experience

10+ post college experience

pre-acquisition & technical due diligence

title: Scientist, Oligonucleotide Synthesis
description:
About Us

Cloverleaf Bio is an early-stage therapeutics company that is developing a new class of engineered RNA therapeutics.

The Job

We are seeking an experienced oligonucleotide synthesis Scientist to join our team. In this position, you will work in close conjunction with our founding team in the creation and development of a completely novel family of RNA therapeutics.

Your responsibilities will include collaborative design and independent synthesis, purification, and characterization of candidate RNA oligonucleotides and conjugates. This role will contribute to the buildout of our RNA synthesis platform and establishing methodologies, including troubleshooting technical challenges to accelerate the development of our RNA therapeutics.

When & Where

Location: Boston, MA

Work Model: Full-time onsite

About You

Excited by the science. We are excited by how science can improve the world and are looking for people who are too.

Flexible. We wear many different hats and are looking for people who are willing to do whatever it takes to pitch in and get the job done.

Resilient. Working in an early-stage startup can be hard. Science is hard. We are looking for people who have a demonstrated track record of sticking with complex problems for the long haul.

Cooperative. As a small team, communication and collaboration are key. We are looking for people who thrive working both independently and collaboratively.

Qualifications:

  • PhD or MS with 4+ years of experience in oligonucleotide chemistry.
  • Must have direct experience with Mermade or Dr. Oligo high-throughput synthesizers, LC/HRMS, UPHPLC, LC/MS analytics.
  • Ability to independently carry out all steps of oligonucleotide synthesis and quality control.
  • Proficiency in RNA oligonucleotide synthesis of various lengths and biological understanding of industry-standard oligonucleotide modifications.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with oligonucleotide conjugation, particularly antibody-RNA conjugation.
  • Experience with design/development of RNA therapeutics.
  • Experience with lipid nanoparticle encapsulation and characterization.
  • Molecular biology/biochemistry experience in RNA biochemistry and/or protein biochemistry.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience and strong equity incentives.
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • 401k retirement including employer match.
  • A stimulating, collegial, and fast-paced environment.
