title: Structural Steel Project Manager - Data Centre
description:
About the Company



A leading Irish engineering contractor delivering mechanical, structural steel and offsite manufactured solutions for major data centre, pharmaceutical and industrial projects across Ireland and Europe. They are strengthening their site delivery team on a major data centre project in Clondalkin, Dublin. You'll join a growing, well-established business with a strong pipeline of mission-critical work.



About the Role



Structural Project Manager



Structural Steel | OFCI | Data Centres



Location: Clondalkin, Dublin, Ireland – data centre project (site-based)



Job type: Full-time, permanent



Right to work: Candidates must have the right to work in Ireland



As Structural Project Manager you'll lead the delivery of structural Owner Furnished, Contractor Installed (OFCI) packages on a major data centre project in Clondalkin, managing everything from receipt of materials through to installation and handover. This is a site-based leadership role where you'll manage site teams and subcontractors and work closely with the client, main contractor and design teams.



Responsibilities



  • Lead the delivery of structural OFCI packages, including structural steel, supports, platforms and associated works, on a live data centre project.
  • Manage the interface with the client and main contractor on owner-furnished materials, including delivery schedules, receipt, storage and installation.
  • Plan, manage and report against the project programme, making sure key milestones are met.
  • Manage site supervisors, steel fixers, erectors and subcontractors, setting priorities and allocating resources.
  • Coordinate structural works with mechanical, electrical and architectural trades, and resolve interface and sequencing issues.
  • Review drawings, method statements and lifting plans, and manage RFIs, technical queries and change.
  • Drive quality control, inspection and test plans and the completion of quality documentation.
  • Promote and enforce the highest standards of Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) on site, particularly for lifting and working at height.
  • Prepare and present progress reports to senior management and the client.



Qualifications



  • A degree or HND in Civil or Structural Engineering, or Construction Management.



Required Skills



We're looking for an experienced structural project manager with a strong track record on data centre projects. You will have:



  • Proven data centre project experience (essential).
  • Significant experience managing structural steel or structural packages for a specialist contractor or main contractor.
  • Experience of OFCI packages, or of managing owner-furnished materials and client interfaces on large projects.
  • A strong understanding of steel erection, lifting operations and site logistics.
  • Experience managing site teams, subcontractors and programmes on large, fast-paced projects.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, and confidence dealing with clients and main contractors.
  • The right to work in Ireland (essential).



Preferred Skills



  • Experience with offsite manufactured or modular structural solutions.
  • Knowledge of steel fabrication standards and quality requirements (e.g. EN 1090).
  • Safe Pass and relevant EHS training (e.g. IOSH Managing Safely).



Pay range and compensation package


  • Salary of €85,000 – €100,000, dependent on experience, plus benefits.
  • Permanent role with a leading engineering contractor.
  • Long-term work on major data centre projects in the Dublin area.
  • A strong pipeline of projects with clear progression opportunities.

title: Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure) based in Switzerland.

We are looking for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer to help build and operate the server infrastructure powering a large-scale AI cloud platform. In this role, you will oversee the entire lifecycle of server hardware, from initial provisioning and deployment to maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning. You will design reliable infrastructure services and automation that improve fleet performance, availability, and operational efficiency. Working across CPU and GPU platforms, Linux systems, and distributed infrastructure, you will tackle complex engineering challenges with direct business impact. As a senior technical contributor, you will also influence architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and help shape the team's long-term technical direction within a fast-growing international engineering environment.

Accountabilities

As a Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will take ownership of critical infrastructure initiatives, combining hands-on software engineering with technical leadership to ensure the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of the server fleet. You will collaborate with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking specialists, and hardware suppliers to continuously improve infrastructure operations.

  • Design, develop, and operate infrastructure services covering network booting, server provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and hardware decommissioning.
  • Lead complex technical initiatives from initial problem definition and architectural design through implementation, deployment, and production operations.
  • Contribute to the team's technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integrations, and long-term engineering priorities.
  • Define and monitor meaningful reliability indicators and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to guide technical decisions and engineering investments.
  • Reduce operational overhead by transforming recurring failures, manual procedures, and repetitive tasks into robust automated solutions.
  • Improve on-call processes, incident response practices, and operational resilience through structured, blameless incident reviews.
  • Strengthen infrastructure observability, monitoring, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and overall production readiness.
  • Drive support for new CPU and GPU hardware platforms while improving the underlying GNU/Linux system.
  • Provide technical mentorship, conduct design and code reviews, and promote sound software engineering and reliability practices.
  • Coordinate technical delivery across multiple engineering and operational teams, communicate architectural trade-offs, and resolve cross-team dependencies.
  • Investigate complex production issues and implement long-term solutions to improve infrastructure stability and performance.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with extensive experience in Linux-based infrastructure and distributed systems. You should combine practical SRE expertise with sound architectural judgment, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to influence technical decisions. Depending on your experience level, you will contribute through hands-on engineering, technical leadership, mentoring, and broader architectural ownership.

  • Strong software engineering experience with Go and a solid understanding of Linux systems.
  • Proven experience designing, developing, and operating infrastructure services and distributed systems, including failure handling and recovery mechanisms.
  • Demonstrated ability to own complex technical projects and successfully bring them into production.
  • Practical knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering principles, including Service Level Objectives (SLOs), observability, incident management, capacity planning, and operational toil reduction.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to guide architectural decisions and troubleshoot complex production problems.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, conducting technical reviews, and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical leadership.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both engineering and infrastructure operations teams.
  • Experience with hardware provisioning, bare-metal infrastructure, GPU platforms, or large-scale server fleets is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform is beneficial.
  • Ability to balance hands-on technical contributions with broader ownership and cross-team coordination.
  • Willingness to participate in coding interviews as part of the recruitment process.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the country where the position is based and provide proof of employment eligibility.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Career development and continuous learning opportunities.
  • Flexible working environment with significant autonomy and technical ownership.
  • Collaborative and innovative engineering culture.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful AI infrastructure and large-scale cloud computing projects.
  • International working environment alongside experienced engineers and talented technical teams.

The Senior Specialist partners with colleagues across corporate (enterprise) communications, divisional communications and functional leaders at the site. title: Ladder Liaison - Western MA
description:
Public Job Title: Ladder Liaison - Community Engagement Manager (Western MA)
Location: Springfield, MA (Pioneer Valley Area) or Worcester, MA

About Us: Ladder Health, an innovative virtual care platform, developed and tested at Boston Children's Hospital, serves as an end-to-end developmental partner for children (0–6 years old) with developmental delays. Ladder offers an alternative to waitlisted state-based programs or private pay practices, guiding families through our developmental screener, clinical evaluations, and comprehensive virtual care with specialized therapists (PT, OT, SLP and feeding therapists). Our platform supports a coordinated care plan with resources, HIPAA-compliant messaging, and integration with pediatric care teams, primarily monetized through Fee-for-Service (FFS) therapy revenues. Ladder Health partners with pediatricians and community organizations to improve access and quality of care for families by connecting the broader network of people who support young children and their caregivers to timely developmental resources and clinical services.

The Role: Ladder Health is expanding its services across western Massachusetts and seeking motivated, community-oriented relationship managers to build and sustain strategic partnerships. This role focuses on developing referral relationships with local pediatricians, healthcare providers, educational centers, and social service agencies to ensure that families in the community can access high-quality early intervention services. While pediatricians and family medicine providers remain the foundation of our referral model, we are intentionally expanding our reach through a broader network of community partners—including Head Start programs, home-visiting organizations, early childhood educators, childcare and daycare centers, and family-serving community organizations. These partners are often among the first to recognize developmental concerns and can play an important role in helping families navigate the path to care. At its core, this is an account management and community-focused role. We know firsthand that building a referral pipeline takes time and consistent, in person trust building. It’s how you nurture that relationship in the 30 to 60 days after the first referral, not the initial pitch, that turns a one-time contact into a lasting, healthy partner. We're looking for someone who thrives on the long game of an ongoing relationship, not just the win of a first "yes."

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and Sustain Strategic Partnerships: Establish and maintain relationships with local pediatricians, clinics, family medicine practices, early childhood programs, educational centers, and social service organizations through targeted outreach and community engagement, including a deliberate, ongoing follow-up cadence across a full spectrum of digital communications, warm introductions and direct in-person engagement, especially in the critical weeks immediately following a partner's first referral.
  • Educational Presentations: Conduct impactful in-service presentations and workshops tailored to each partner type to educate on Ladder Health’s offerings, developmental milestones, and referral processes and help community partners recognize developmental concerns and connect families to appropriate resources and care.
  • Partner Feedback Loops: Facilitate partner Q&A sessions while architecting custom workflows and feedback loops to streamline collaboration and optimize the referral experience.
  • Customized Engagement Plans: Create and execute partner-specific engagement strategies, including a calendared check-in schedule through at least the first 90 days after a partner's first referral, to align with the goals of pediatric providers, educators, and social services and build sustainable pathways for families to access care through both clinical and community-based relationships.
  • Personal Follow-Through: Reinforce Ladder Health's automated partner communications (screening tools, educational resources, referral guidelines) with a real, local point of contact; the personal relationship is what our data shows makes those materials land.
  • Portfolio Health Management: Regularly review your existing partner base to identify accounts that have gone quiet or slowed their referral activity, and proactively re-engage them; sustaining a healthy existing relationship is as valuable as building a new one.
  • Community Outreach: Participate in local health fairs, community events, and informational sessions to strengthen community presence and relationships, prioritizing the partners and moments where in-person time has the most impact, since travel is a real and limited resource. Build visibility and trusted relationships across the early childhood ecosystem, including community-based organizations and programs that regularly engage families with young children.
  • Feedback and Adaptation: Collect feedback from partners, address challenges, and work collaboratively to refine the referral and service processes for maximum efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Internal Teams: Work closely with marketing, product, and technical teams, who own the automated email campaigns and educational content that keep partners engaged between visits, to develop materials and systems that support partner engagement and make integration seamless; this partnership is what frees the Liaison to focus on the in-person, relationship-building work that only a locally present person can do.
  • Collaborate with Growth Colleagues: Work closely with senior leadership and growth resources to support strategic partners and relationships with large health system partners in your market to expand local referral relationships into durable, sustainable partnerships and identify opportunities to connect clinical referral networks with community-based organizations.
  • CRM Management: Consistently and promptly track and document partner interactions (calls, visits, and every follow-up) in the company CRM system, ensuring accurate reporting and follow-ups.

Who You Are:

  • Experience: 5+ years in business development, account management or partnership roles, preferably in pediatric healthcare, early childhood education, or community services
  • Community Network: Existing strong connections within local healthcare, education, and social service networks and/or the ability to build trusted relationships across the early childhood and family-support ecosystem.
  • Presentation Skills: Excellent public speaking and presentation abilities for training and educational outreach
  • Innovative and Adaptive: Comfortable testing new outreach tactics and adjusting strategies based on partner feedback
  • CRM Proficiency: Experienced in using CRM tools for tracking and reporting, with the discipline to log activity consistently even when busy, this data directly shapes how the team prioritizes follow-up
  • Passionate About Pediatric Healthcare: Demonstrated commitment to improving access to developmental care
  • Self-Motivated and Patient: Thrives in an environment with limited oversight and embraces a growth mindset; comfortable playing a long game, building a healthy, repeat-referring partnership typically takes months of consistent, mixed-channel follow-up, not a single great first meeting
  • Relationship-Oriented Follow-Through: Builds a genuine, ongoing cadence with partners rather than treating outreach as a one-time event, especially right after a partner's first referral, which our data shows is the single biggest factor in whether that relationship grows
  • Travel: Willingness to travel locally up to 100% within a 150-mile radius, understood as central to the role: in-person presence is what our data shows most reliably builds the trust that leads to a first referral and healthy referral partnerships

What Success Looks Like: Your role is measured by the health and consistency of your partner relationships and referral activity, not by whether every individual referral results in a scheduled family, which depends on factors outside your control, including family engagement and our clinical operations team. We know in healthcare trust is earned, not assumed, and the success of this role depends on how well you establish yourself as a trusted resource to community partners, serving as a thought-leader, problem solver and network builder to help children and families access developmental care earlier. Success also means building a connected local ecosystem in which pediatric providers remain a strong referral foundation, while community partners increasingly recognize developmental needs, understand available resources, and help families take the next step toward care.

Equal Opportunity Statement: Ladder Health is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Important Security Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. Representatives from Ladder Health will never conduct interviews purely via text/chat apps, nor will we ever ask for banking details, direct deposit info, or credit card numbers during the interview process. Official communications will only come from an @ladderhealth.co email address. If you suspect fraud, please report it to us directly.

title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation and control stack of the fusion energy reactors of the future.


Our technology enables effective and reliable operation, monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices — which will one day provide clean, practically limitless power to the grid. We have spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and have just completed our pre-seed fundraise.


We are looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to join our founding team in Lausanne and help build our core technology.


This job is for you if you are a passionate engineer with deep knowledge cutting across real-time / embedded systems, software and hardware, and excited about building the systems to monitor and control real-world fusion plasmas.


Tasks



  • Implement real-time control, analysis, data acquisition systems in the kHz to MHz range, as individual contributor and in a team.

  • Integrate solutions across a variety of company products and services as well as on our in-house test beds.

  • Provide technical leadership within a growing real-time control and software engineering team that you will help to build.

  • Translate customer needs into requirements and specifications.



Requirements



  • Experience taking hard-real-time acquisition and control loops from incomplete requirements through to commissioning on hardware, in domains such as automotive, robotics, embedded, electrical and/or scientific instrumentation.

  • ‘Full stack’: familiarity with all aspects of real-time technologies, from physical/DAQ, real-time software frameworks and middleware, real-time OS and integration.

  • Fluency in a mix of high-level and low-level languages such as C, C++, Rust, MATLAB/Simulink, Python. Obsession with code quality, testing and reliability.

  • Experience with distributed real-time systems, real-time networking and field buses and/or SCADA is an advantage.

  • Experience with embedded/μC/FPGA technologies and/or safety critical systems is an advantage.



Benefits



  • The unique opportunity to play a foundational role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

  • The opportunity to build cutting edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

  • Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.

  • Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance.



If you are excited about joining our team, send your CV including information about a real-time system you have taken into operation. We're looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
::: KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES :::

Reservoir Performance Analysis and Standard Analytical Modelling

  • Construct and maintain standard analytical models for reservoir performance analysis and prediction (Eclipse, Petrel-RE, Rubis, MBAL, PVTP)
  • Conduct analysis and evaluation of wells including history of production, pressure history, well interval records, etc.
  • Predict and evaluate waterflood/ secondary recovery process performance and potential recovery factors
  • Assess gaps in subsurface data requirements and implement requests for PVT samples, static gradient pressure measurements, pressure transient tests, etc.
  • Develop and implement cost-effective reservoir monitoring and surveillance programs; optimize production and injection rates
  • Assess various reservoir drive mechanisms present in field and best way forward for depletion
  • Perform pressure analysis and Pressure Transient Analysis using Ecrin software (Saphir)
  • Develop and implement standards and consistent methodologies across Thailand BU WRT reservoir evaluation and management.
  • Act as an internal consultant and provide technical and management support to Thailand BU assets.

Reservoir Characterization and Static Modelling

  • Support Geologist and Geophysicist in estimating original fluid volumes in place using deterministic and probabilistic methods
  • Complete reservoir evaluation using logs, core, pressure transient data; Collaborate with Formation Evaluation experts on design of core and Petrophysics studies.
  • Assess rock and fluid properties for input to simulation; Characterize Fluid systems including use of EOS (PVTP)
  • Design basic RCA and SCAL programs for Pc, Kr, wettability, etc. and assist in the interpretation of results when provided
  • Derive permeability and perm/transmissibility predictions using state of the art analysis
  • Assist with fluid contact interpretations (reconcile well logs, seismic attributes and MDT pressures) and reflect the full range of possible outcomes
  • Assist with appropriate upscaling of geological model ensuring the main features of geologic model are retained.

Reservoir Simulation and Dynamic Model Building

  • Construct and maintain numerical reservoir simulation models for reservoir performance analysis and prediction (Eclipse, Petrel-RE, Rubis, MBAL)
  • Design models to assess water and gas coning, cusping and channelling.
  • Recognize errors and uncertainties associated with input data when history matching (pressure, rates, WOR, etc.)
  • Work closely with earth scientists to iterate on geological model realizations that best match the reservoir history.
  • Ensure dynamic behaviour of the reservoir is adequately represented in models (aquifer strength/gas cap size, Pb, liquid drop out, J-function water saturations etc.)
  • Predict production performance and EUR/TUR for infill well proposals and recompletion activities

Hydrocarbon Resource Management

  • Create probabilistic (10/50/90) forecast and EUR/TUR estimates from modelling work
  • Summarize Reservoir Depletion Plans for field and individual sands/compartments
  • In conjunction with Petroleum Engineer, Generate field short term production forecasts, Life of Field forecasts and provide input to the end of year reserves process
  • Ensure appropriate use of Horizontal wells for reservoir management
  • Coordinate annual reserves efforts by working with development team and independent qualified reserves evaluators
  • Enhanced Oil recovery (EOR) feasibility assessment and predictions

Identify New Opportunities and Technologies

  • Plan and evaluate trials of new reservoir technology; directing and participating in feasibility studies
  • Identify unswept or inefficiently drained areas and recommend new well locations with geological input.

Exploration and Appraisal Well Support

  • Monitor the execution of XPT/MDT, Mini-DST, and other well testing and sampling programs.
  • Prepare conceptual development plans for exploration prospects.

﻿﻿﻿

:: QUALIFICATIONS :::

﻿﻿Knowledge & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Petroleum or Reservoir).
  • Or a master's degree in Reservoir Engineering is a definite advantage.
  • 15-20 Years of reservoir engineering experience in the oil and gas industry with at least 10 years in reservoir simulation.

Experience:

  • Experience in modelling oil and gas reservoirs, preferably with Petrel RE and Eclipse E100/300.
  • Experience working in different countries is preferred, especially Asia-Pacific.
  • Achieved QRE status; Reserves auditor level of experience is an added advantage.

Skills:﻿

  • Applies functional skills in own area and other areas to solve business problems; sets technical/business objectives with manager.
  • Software: Eclipse E100/300, Petrel-RE, Rubis, MBAL, PVTP, Prosper, GAP, OFM, Saphir; Knowledge of Reservoir Engineering software and techniques to an advanced level.
  • Mentor and aid in the development of less experienced engineering staff; capable of probabilistic analysis methods.
  • Ability to design and optimize reservoir fluid sampling, fluid property modelling, routine and special core analysis; Capable of specialized simulation techniques (matrix solution methods, numerical analysis, vectorization, finite element/difference analysis and parallel modelling).
  • Advanced Excel skills are a distinct advantage.

Work Condition:

  • Enjoy a dynamic on-site work environment, 5 days a week.
  • While there is no hybrid work option available, the company offers ﻿flexible working hours, commitment to work-life balance.

title: Senior Sustainability Engineer
description:
Please Note Before Applying

This is a full-time, office-based position in Clonee, Co. Dublin. It is not a remote or hybrid role.


Applicants must:

  • Be currently based in Ireland
  • Have an existing legal entitlement to work in Ireland
  • Be available to work full-time from the Clonee office
  • Have a minimum of 7 years’ relevant professional experience
  • Have substantial practical experience with Irish Building Regulations, Non-Domestic Part L and NEAP
  • Be currently qualified/registered to undertake SEAI Non-Domestic BER assessments
  • Employment permit sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available for this position.


Applications that do not meet the above requirements will not be considered.


The Position:

A growing engineering consultancy is looking to appoint a Senior Sustainability Engineer/ Sustainability Lead to lead and develop the sustainability department within the practice. This is a senior, hands-on position for someone with strong experience in building performance, dynamic

simulation modelling and Part L compliance. The successful candidate will work closely with the mechanical and electrical engineers and will take responsibility for sustainability input across a wide range of projects. We are looking for someone who is technically very strong, comfortable dealing directly with clients and design teams, and capable of taking ownership of the sustainability function as it grows. The role may suit an experienced Senior Sustainability Engineer, Building Performance Engineer or Sustainability Consultant who is ready to take on greater responsibility and lead this area of the practice.


The Role:

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

  • Leading sustainability and building-performance work across projects
  • Carrying out and reviewing IES VE dynamic simulation models
  • Preparing Non-Domestic Part L compliance assessments
  • Carrying out and issuing Non-Domestic BER assessments
  • Undertaking and reviewing NEAP assessments
  • Carrying out overheating, thermal comfort, natural ventilation and energy-performance studies
  • Advising architects and design teams on building fabric, glazing, solar gain, air permeability and other energy-related design issues
  • Advising on low-energy and low-carbon building design
  • Assessing heat pumps, renewable-energy systems, PV and other low-carbon technologies
  • Preparing energy and decarbonisation strategies for new and existing buildings
  • Undertaking feasibility studies and option appraisals
  • Preparing technical reports and sustainability submissions
  • Attending client and design-team meetings
  • Coordinating sustainability requirements with our mechanical and electrical design teams
  • Reviewing project designs for compliance with energy and sustainability requirements
  • Developing internal sustainability procedures, standards and QA processes
  • Providing technical guidance and support to other members of the team
  • Supporting and mentoring junior staff
  • Helping develop and expand the sustainability services offered by the practice


Essential Requirements:

Applicants should have:

  • A degree in Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Sustainable Energy, Building Physics or a related discipline
  • A minimum of 7 years’ relevant professional experience in sustainability, building performance, energy or building-services consultancy
  • Significant experience delivering sustainability and energy assessments for projects in Ireland
  • Substantial practical experience with Irish Building Regulations and the Irish building-energy regulatory framework
  • Extensive experience carrying out Part L compliance assessments for non-domestic buildings in Ireland
  • Current SEAI Non-Domestic BER Assessor registration
  • Excellent working knowledge of NEAP
  • Expert-level competence in IES Virtual Environment (IES VE) with substantial experience developing and analysing dynamic simulation models
  • Experience with complex building-performance analysis
  • Strong knowledge of building physics, thermal performance, overheating, natural ventilation and low-energy design
  • Good understanding of mechanical and electrical building services and their interaction with building energy performance
  • Experience working as part of multidisciplinary design teams
  • Experience taking technical responsibility for projects
  • Strong technical report-writing and communication skills
  • Ability to manage several projects at the same time
  • Confidence dealing directly with clients, architects, engineers and other consultants
  • Ability to provide technical leadership and review the work of others
  • Previous experience supervising, mentoring or leading other staff would be advantageous, but previous experience as a formal department head is not essential


Additional Experience:

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:

  • BREEAM
  • LEED
  • WELL
  • Embodied carbon assessment
  • Life-cycle assessment
  • Operational energy modelling
  • Building decarbonisation studies
  • Energy audits
  • Digital tools or automation used in building-performance analysis
  • Chartered Engineer status, or progress towards an appropriate professional qualification, would also be beneficial


Leading the Sustainability Department:

This role is intended for someone who can take responsibility for the sustainability function within the company. As well as delivering project work, the successful candidate will help develop how sustainability services are delivered within the practice. This will include improving internal standards, reviewing technical quality, supporting junior staff and identifying areas where we can expand our sustainability offering. The successful candidate will work closely with company management and will have a significant input into how the department develops. We are also interested in making better use of digital tools, automation and AI where they can genuinely improve modelling, analysis, reporting or QA. Experience in this area would be useful but is not essential.


What We Offer:

  • Salary of €70,000–€80,000 depending on experience
  • Company pension scheme
  • Permanent senior position
  • Responsibility for leading and developing the sustainability department
  • Direct involvement with company management
  • Varied project workload across education, healthcare, commercial, residential and public-sector projects
  • Strong client and design-team exposure
  • Opportunity to develop and expand the sustainability services offered by the practice
  • Support for continued professional development
  • Good long-term progression within a growing consultancy
  • Office based in Clonee, Co. Dublin


If you have strong experience in IES VE, Non-Domestic Part L and BER assessment and are looking for a senior role with responsibility for developing a sustainability function, we would be interested in hearing from you.

title: Director of Client Engineering - Trading Platform
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Client Engineering - Trading Platform based in Ireland.

This is a senior engineering leadership opportunity for an experienced technology leader to oversee the development and delivery of a sophisticated web-based trading platform and its mobile applications. You will take full ownership of client engineering, ensuring that product releases are delivered on schedule, meet high-quality standards, and operate reliably. Leading a distributed engineering organization across Europe and India, you will establish technical direction, strengthen engineering processes, and build a high-performing leadership team. Working closely with executive stakeholders and product leadership, you will drive accountability across delivery, architecture, quality assurance, and team development. This is a hands-on leadership position focused on guiding teams, reviewing critical technical decisions, and creating a scalable engineering organization.

Accountabilities

As Director of Client Engineering, you will be responsible for the overall delivery, technical quality, and organizational performance of the client engineering function. You will establish clear engineering standards, develop leadership capabilities, and ensure consistent execution across web, mobile, and website development.

  • Own delivery commitments for the web trading terminal, mobile applications, and website in collaboration with product leadership.
  • Establish, implement, and enforce engineering standards covering branching strategies, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and release management.
  • Own the release approval process and ensure that every product release meets defined quality and reliability standards.
  • Build and structure the engineering organization by recruiting and developing engineering managers, staff engineers, terminal and mobile engineers, and a QA lead.
  • Define technical direction and make key architectural decisions for web and mobile products.
  • Personally review complex technical designs and guide the resolution of critical engineering challenges.
  • Manage and coach engineering managers, establish performance objectives, and oversee their professional development.
  • Lead quality assurance activities and ensure that the QA function is integrated into the engineering delivery process.
  • Monitor and communicate engineering performance through regular reporting on delivery timelines, defects, and release health.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership and product stakeholders to align engineering priorities with business objectives.
  • Establish a reliable delivery structure within the first three to six months, ensuring predictable releases and strong technical leadership across the team.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering executive with a proven track record of leading large software engineering organizations and delivering production-grade web or mobile products. You should combine strong technical judgment with people leadership, operational discipline, and experience in financial technology or trading-related environments.

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience working on production web or mobile products.
  • Proven experience leading an engineering organization of at least 10 engineers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing engineering managers, rather than exclusively leading individual contributors.
  • Strong background in owning engineering delivery, release management, and quality standards for production products.
  • Practical expertise in branching strategies, code review processes, CI/CD pipelines, and structured release approval frameworks.
  • Previous engineering leadership experience in at least one of the following sectors: trading, brokerage, fintech, or market data.
  • Based in Europe, within a UK or EU time zone, with at least four hours of working-day overlap with the 09:00–18:00 IST schedule.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage distributed teams and establish clear accountability.

title: Title Examiner (Remote - Ohio)
description:
Who We Are

First American Title Insurance Company, one of the nation's largest title insurers, provides comprehensive title insurance coverage and professional services for residential, commercial, and new construction purchases, along with refinances and equity loans. Join a team that provides dedicated resources to our policy-issuing agents with services that use modern technology, innovative tools, and close collaboration to help clients navigate real estate transactions with confidence. What We Do

Search public records and examine titles to determine legal condition of property title, primarily for residential properties. Copy or summarize recorded documents, which affect the condition of title to the property. These roles may be found in production center or branch office environments.   • Resolves most issues such as missing information, incomplete, inaccurate or contradictory information contained in the title documentation

  • Communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Customer service orientation

Our people first culture is built on creating a workplace where different perspectives are welcomed, respected, and valued. We believe teams are stronger when employees feel supported, included, and encouraged to contribute as themselves. Here, you’ll be part of a culture built on collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous improvement — so you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and help move our customers, communities, and company forward.

title: Senior Analyst - Customer Advocacy
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

Caring is one of United’s most important principles. And no one exemplifies that more than our Customer Contact Center team, who helps our customers with everything from booking and managing reservations, to questions about their travel, MileagePlus accounts, and so much more! Are you a people person? Do you get fulfillment from helping others? Then join a team that cares for our customers and makes a positive impact on their travel experience, every single day.

Job Overview and Responsibilities

The Senior Analyst - Customer Advocacy will work with the Director, Customer Advocacy to promote the inclusion of customer viewpoints in all decisions the airline makes. Together they will pursue solutions to complex customer opportunities that often feel like the “right thing to do” but have not yet been solved. The Sr. Analyst will work to identify these critical opportunities, analyze and quantify potential scale, benefits, and costs of solutions, and partner with functional areas across the company for execution. The Sr. Analyst will also support the day-to-day development of executive-facing materials and presentations in support of these initiatives.

  • Work with analytical teams from across United to identify and evaluate complex customer experience opportunities that involve multiple departments to address.
  • With support from their leader, plan and execute analyses in support of prioritized Customer Advocacy initiatives, including defining potential scope, quantifying potential benefit/impact, and estimating potential costs.
  • Create and maintain both repeatable and ad-hoc executive level presentation materials in support of prioritized initiatives, conveying findings from analyses, sharing status/progress updates, and seeking input from leader as needed
  • Explore and develop new capabilities and form new relationships within United on behalf of the Customer Advocacy portfolio and serve as a proponent to the rest of United of the Customer Advocacy mission statement.
  • Contribute positively to team and United culture by being engaged, communicating clearly and openly, and demonstrating a commitment to personal and professional development and growth.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree or 4 years of relevant work experience
  • Quantitative field (engineering, business analytics, information systems, aviation management or related degree)
  • 2+ years of experience in an analytical role
  • 3+ years of related worked experience
  • Passionate about ensuring customer experiences are fair, consistent, and intuitive while in pursuit of excellence
  • Experience working with large datasets and analytical tools to tell a story using data
  • Familiarity with database interface tools, SQL and programming concepts
  • Strong organization skills, ability to work independently, and prioritize efforts across multiple projects
  • Strong communication skills and ability to develop executive-level presentations with support from your leader
  • Familiarity with broader airline management concepts and organizational structures
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Master's degree
  • 3+ years of experience in an analytical role within an airline

  • Experience as a customer of multiple airlines with familiarity of potential airline customer frustration points

  • Participant in or regular follower of airline customer forums (e.g., FlyerTalk, Reddit), with insight into customer perspectives on policies, loyalty programs, and service

  • Experience using AI tools to analyze data, organize work, and improve personal efficiency

title: KY Region ED Director
description:
Mission Statement

To advance the health and wellbeing of our community with a compassionate and caring spirit.

Job Summary

The KY Regional Director of Emergency Services provides leadership and operational oversight for Emergency Departments across Deaconess Health System's Kentucky region. Reporting to the Kentucky Region Chief Operating Officer and collaborating with the Chief Nursing Officer, this position provides direction and accountability for ED managers while driving improvements in quality, patient safety, patient experience, and patient throughput. The Director promotes operational consistency, workforce engagement, and collaboration across regional hospitals, critical access facilities, and affiliated organizations. This role maintains 24-hour accountability for Emergency Department operations and ensures continuity of patient care throughout the organization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provides leadership, direction, and oversight to Emergency Department managers and staff throughout the Kentucky region.

  • Establishes departmental goals, performance expectations, and productivity metrics aligned with organizational priorities.

  • Promotes consistent operational practices, leadership structures, and best-practice sharing across regional Emergency Departments.

  • Collaborates with hospital leadership, nursing leaders, physicians, and other departments to improve patient care and operational efficiency.

  • Oversees quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Monitors performance indicators and utilizes data to identify opportunities for improvement and implement corrective action plans.

  • Identifies operational risks and develops strategies to address concerns and improve patient care.

  • Promotes positive patient, physician, and employee experiences through effective communication, service recovery, and relationship building.

  • Evaluates patient and employee satisfaction feedback to identify trends and improve service delivery.

  • Oversees workforce management, including recruitment, hiring, staff development, orientation, performance management, and employee retention.

  • Develops and supports a positive work environment that encourages employee engagement, professional development, and accountability.

  • Develops and manages operating budgets and capital expenditures to support organizational goals.

  • Monitors departmental expenses and identifies opportunities to improve financial performance without compromising quality of care.

  • Supports the development and implementation of new programs, services, and operational initiatives.

  • Collaborates with other Emergency Services Regional Directors and affiliated facilities to promote consistency and operational excellence.

Education & Experience

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing required.

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Nursing, or a related field required.

  • Minimum of five years of clinical unit experience preferred.

  • Minimum of three years of leadership experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with physicians, nursing leaders, and other healthcare professionals.

  • Knowledge of healthcare operations, quality improvement, patient safety, and regulatory compliance.

  • Ability to analyze operational and financial data and develop strategies for improvement.

  • Experience with budgeting, fiscal management, workforce planning, and resource allocation.

  • Ability to identify problems, make sound decisions, and implement effective solutions.

  • Strong presentation, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead effectively in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

  • Proficiency with computer systems, data management, and performance reporting tools.

Licensure & Certifications

  • Current Registered Nurse (RN) licensure in the State of Kentucky required.

  • Current AHA Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.

  • Current AHA Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certification required.

  • Current AHA Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) certification required.

title: AI Safety & Red Teaming Lead
description:
Alice is seeking an experienced, technically fluent AI Safety & Red Teaming Lead to oversee end-to-end delivery for a high-stakes Generative AI safety engagement in London. You will lead a specialized multidisciplinary pod of Child Safety Researchers, reverse engineers, and adversarial jailbreakers—bridging deep domain intelligence with highly technical exploit and evaluation methodologies. You will own program execution, approve adversarial testing designs, ensure strict operational security, and present key findings and strategic recommendations directly to client leadership.


Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery & Program Management: Own the full delivery lifecycle from scoping and methodology design through execution, quality assurance, and final reporting—ensuring milestones, SLAs, and safety benchmarks are consistently met.
  • Multidisciplinary Team Leadership: Manage, mentor, and coordinate a 100% on-site team of Child Safety Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), reverse engineers, and AI jailbreakers, balancing workloads, prioritizing high-risk vectors, and fostering psychological safety and resilience.
  • Methodology Review & Technical Approval: Review, challenge, and approve adversarial testing frameworks, red-teaming methodologies, exploit techniques, and automated evaluation pipelines across text, image, video, multimodal, text-to-3D, and physical AI systems.
  • Client Stakeholder Management & Executive Reporting: Serve as the primary day-to-day and executive liaison with external stakeholders. Lead technical briefings, defend research methodologies, synthesize complex findings into executive-ready presentations, and align testing outputs with evolving client policy and product roadmaps.
  • Operational Security & Wellbeing Governance: Enforce strict compliance within a secured, access-controlled environment while proactively managing team wellbeing, exposure rotation, and resilience protocols for staff handling graphic and distressing child safety material.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Leadership & Delivery Experience: Minimum 7+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, AI Red Teaming, Threat Intelligence, or Offensive Security, including at least 3+ years directly managing multidisciplinary technical and investigative teams.
  • End-to-End Program Ownership: Proven track record managing complex, high-stakes client or enterprise engagements from inception to final executive delivery under tight timelines.
  • Child Safety & Online Harms Literacy: Strong understanding of online child exploitation (CSAE/CSAM), grooming dynamics, and adversarial evasion tactics, with the operational maturity to lead teams exposed to severe online harms.
  • Technical & Adversarial Fluency: Deep working knowledge of Generative AI architectures, LLM/multimodal vulnerabilities, jailbreaking techniques, reverse engineering concepts, and automated evaluation tooling—sufficient to rigorously critique and approve methodologies designed by senior technical specialists.
  • Executive Communication & Client Presence: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with extensive experience presenting technical findings, risk assessments, and policy recommendations directly to senior external stakeholders (such as Big Tech product, policy, and engineering leads).
  • Workplace & Security Compliance: Ability to work full-time (5 days a week) on-site at our London office within a strictly secured, access-controlled environment.
  • Content Resilience: Demonstrated psychological resilience and emotional maturity to oversee high-severity child safety investigations and support team wellbeing under continuous exposure to distressing material.

About Alice

Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines.

In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection.

Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms.

If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

title: Project Consultant
description:
Senior Project Lead Consultant – Event Centre


Contract - Onsite

Location: Limerick, Ireland

Department: Engineering

Project Phase: Detailed Design, Construction & Handover


The Opportunity


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Lead Consultant to lead the detailed design, construction and handover phases of a significant Event Centre development in Limerick.

The project involves the sensitive restoration and adaptive reuse of historic 19th-century stables and outbuildings within the grounds of a protected heritage structure. The development will transform approximately 1,482m² of existing and new space into a contemporary Event Centre, incorporating a glazed courtyard enclosure, flexible vendor units, external plant areas, landscaping and associated infrastructure.


This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Project Manager with a strong construction or engineering background to take ownership of a complex, high-profile project involving both heritage restoration and modern construction.


Key Responsibilities


Project Delivery & Management

  • Lead the project through detailed design, procurement, construction and final handover.
  • Develop and manage project programmes, budgets, cost reporting and change control.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary design teams, including architectural, structural, M&E, conservation, landscape and ecological consultants.
  • Ensure project milestones, resources and deliverables are effectively managed.


Design, Planning & Compliance

  • Ensure all design and construction activities align with approved planning conditions and conservation requirements.
  • Coordinate with local authorities, conservation specialists and ecological consultants.
  • Ensure compliance with Irish Building Regulations, fire safety, disability access and statutory approval requirements.
  • Oversee the protection and retention of historic building fabric throughout the project.


Construction & Site Management

  • Oversee contractor delivery of demolition, salvage, restoration and new-build works.
  • Manage the interface between existing historic structures and new construction.
  • Coordinate construction activities alongside a live manufacturing facility, including access, sequencing and site logistics.
  • Promote a strong health and safety culture in line with Irish construction legislation.


Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams and external consultants.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key stakeholders, contractors, consultants and local authorities.
  • Provide regular progress updates, reporting on programme, budget, risks and project issues.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure clear accountability across the project team.


Risk, Quality & Handover

  • Identify and manage project risks relating to historic structures, construction, programme, costs and ecological constraints.
  • Ensure construction quality, materials and finishes meet the required design and conservation standards.
  • Lead commissioning, testing, snagging and completion certification.
  • Manage final handover documentation, including as-built drawings, O&M manuals, safety files and statutory certificates.
  • Coordinate operational training, transition to Facilities teams and the defects liability period.


Candidate Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (BS/BEng or equivalent) in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or a related engineering/construction discipline.
  • 7–10 years' relevant project management experience.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex construction projects from detailed design through construction and handover.
  • Demonstrable experience working as a Project Manager on major construction or engineering projects.
  • Strong knowledge of project planning, budgeting, cost control and programme management.
  • Advanced MS Office skills and proficiency with project management software and tools.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and multiple project deliverables effectively.


Desirable Experience

  • Experience delivering refurbishment, heritage restoration, conservation-led or protected structure projects.
  • Knowledge of Irish construction legislation, including Building Control Amendment Regulations (BCAR) and Safety, Health and Welfare at Work (Construction) Regulations.
  • Experience working within or adjacent to live GMP manufacturing or pharmaceutical facilities.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering and construction teams.

title: Tech Transfer Lead
description:
The role:

PE Global is currently recruiting for a Tech Transfer Lead on behalf of a leading biotech company based in Dublin. This is an initial 11 month contract role.


Overview:

The Tech Transfer Lead, Drug Substance Biotech, is responsible for leading the transfer of drug substance manufacturing processes from process development or sending unit into GMP manufacturing, including internal sites and external manufacturing partners. This role with the MS&T team ensures robust technical transfer, process understanding, and operational readiness for clinical and commercial production of biologics. The position serves as a key cross-functional interface among Process Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Analytical, Supply Chain, MSAT, Regulatory, and CDMOs to deliver successful, compliant, and timely transfers.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end technology transfer activities for drug substance biologics processes, including cell culture, upstream, downstream operations and analytical methods
  • Develop and execute transfer strategies, project plans, timelines, risk assessments, and readiness assessments
  • Partner with process development teams to transfer process knowledge, critical process parameters, control strategy, and material attributes into manufacturing
  • Coordinate creation, review, and approval of transfer documentation, including process descriptions, sample plans, bill of materials, protocols, reports, and technical summaries
  • Lead cross-functional transfer teams and facilitate regular governance meetings to ensure alignment on scope, milestones, and risks
  • Support process scale-up, characterization, comparability, and process validation activities as required
  • Ensure analytical methods, sampling plans, raw materials, equipment, and facility requirements are aligned to support successful transfer
  • Identify technical and operational risks and drive mitigation plans to resolution
  • Partner with Quality and Regulatory functions to ensure compliance with cGMP, internal procedures, and applicable regulatory expectations
  • Support deviation investigations, change controls, and CAPA activities related to transfer execution
  • Provide technical oversight during engineering batches, PPQ, or process verification campaigns
  • Support training and knowledge transfer to manufacturing and quality teams at the receiving site
  • Monitor post-transfer performance and lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve process robustness and transfer effectiveness
  • Manage communication with internal & above site/sending unit stakeholders to ensure accountability and timely issue resolution


Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or related scientific/engineering discipline
  • Typically 5–8+ years of experience in biologics process development, MSAT, manufacturing, or technology transfer
  • Strong understanding of drug substance manufacturing for biologics, including upstream and downstream processing
  • Knowledge of cGMP regulations, process validation, and quality systems in a regulated biotech environment
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects and technical teams
  • Excellent communication, organization, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to travel as needed to support site-to-site or partner transfers


Preferred:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a relevant discipline
  • Experience with monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, or other biologic modalities
  • Experience with external manufacturing partners, CMOs, or CDMOs
  • Familiarity with process characterization, scale-down models, and comparability assessments
  • Experience supporting clinical and/or commercial tech transfers
  • Project management experience or certification
